title: A series of tubes: adding interactivity to 3D prints using internal pipes
summary: PipeDream, a Meshmixer extension that routes internal pipes (A*/rod simulation and Euler-tour path routing) through 3D models so 3D prints can be filled post-print with conductive paint, EL wire, light pipe or air for interactivity.

title: FlatFitFab: interactive modeling with planar sections
summary: FlatFitFab is an interactive modeling system for planar section assemblies using a single-stroke drawing workflow, procedural operations, magnetic cut deformation, real-time stress simulation and feasibility tests, with SVG output for fabrication of friction-fit slit models.

title: FlexSense: a transparent self-sensing deformable surface
summary: FlexSense, a transparent thin-film PET sheet with 16 printed piezoelectric P(VDF-TrFE) bend sensors on its periphery, with two algorithms reconstructing the dense 3D shape of the deforming surface in real time.

title: GaussStones: shielded magnetic tangibles for multi-token interactions on portable displays
summary: GaussStones are magnetic tangibles (neodymium magnets inside galvanized steel shield cases) sensed by an analog Hall-sensor grid on the back of portable displays, enabling multi-token applications such as sculpting, board gaming and music performance.

title: Graffiti fur: turning your carpet into a computer display
summary: Fur display technology that draws rewritable patterns on carpets and other fur by raising or flattening fibers, with a roller device, a pen device and a focused-ultrasound pressure projection device.

title: HaptoMime: mid-air haptic interaction with a floating virtual screen
summary: Floating virtual screen formed by an Aerial Imaging Plate reflecting a 10.4-inch LCD, with an IR touch sensor and 40 kHz ultrasonic phased array transducer delivering hands-free tactile feedback via reflection off the plate.

title: High rate, low-latency multi-touch sensing with simultaneous orthogonal multiplexing
summary: Fast Multi-Touch (FMT), a projected capacitive touch sensor that drives all rows simultaneously with orthogonal frequency-division sinusoids and FPGA processing, giving 4000 Hz frame rate and 40 microsecond latency, demonstrated with a high-speed DLP projector.

title: Hover Pad: interacting with autonomous and self-actuated displays in space
summary: A self-actuated display system in which a Nexus 10 tablet mounted on a custom overhead gantry crane moves autonomously in five degrees of freedom above a Microsoft Surface 2 (SUR40), with a toolkit and interaction techniques.

title: LightRing: always-available 2D input on any surface
summary: A ring-form wearable with an infrared proximity sensor for finger flexion and a 1-axis gyroscope for finger rotation that tracks 2d fingertip location on any surface.

title: Loupe: a handheld near-eye display
summary: Loupe is a handheld near-eye display built from an Epson Moverio BT-100 micro-display behind a jeweler's loupe, with a capacitive touch array, IMU and adjustable focal depth for interacting with information feeds.

title: Physical telepresence: shape capture and display for embodied, computer-mediated remote collaboration
summary: Physical Telepresence captures people and objects with a Kinect depth camera and renders them on inFORM and TRANSFORM pin-array shape displays, so remote collaborators can physically embody and manipulate remote objects and shared digital models.

title: PrintScreen: fabricating highly customizable thin-film touch-displays
summary: Printed ultra-thin (120 µm) segmented and passive-matrix thin-film electroluminescent (TFEL) displays with integrated touch sensing, fabricated by screen printing or conductive inkjet printing on paper, PET, leather, metal, stone and wood.

title: RoomAlive: magical experiences enabled by scalable, adaptive projector-camera units
summary: A distributed system of scalable, self-calibrating projector-depth camera (procam) units using Kinect sensors and projectors that turns a living room into an interactive projection-mapped game space adapting content to room geometry and user position.

title: Sensing techniques for tablet+stylus interaction
summary: A sensor-augmented stylus (7x30 capacitive grip grid, IMU) and tablet case (44x26 capacitive grid) on a Samsung Series 7 Slate sensing grip and motion for contextual pen+touch techniques like palm handling, Magnifier Tool and Drafting Tools.

title: Sensory triptych: here, near, out there
summary: Sensory Triptych is a set of child-oriented sensing toys and objects (Earth, Air and Water Explorers with MyPart and MyWater sensors, Adventure Watch, Overhead) that make soil, air, water, nearby places and orbiting satellites perceptible.

title: ShrinkyCircuits: sketching, shrinking, and formgiving for electronic circuits
summary: ShrinkyCircuits is a circuit prototyping technique where circuits are sketched with a conductive pen on prestressed polystyrene Shrinky Dinks sheet and heated so the substrate shrinks to 40%, sintering traces and self-soldering components.

title: SideSwipe: detecting in-air gestures around mobile devices using actual GSM signal
summary: SideSwipe, a four-loop-antenna PCB with RF power detectors attached to a phone that senses unmodified GSM transmission bursts to recognize 14 in-air hand gestures around the device.

title: Skin buttons: cheap, small, low-powered and clickable fixed-icon laser projectors
summary: Skin Buttons are tiny fixed-icon laser projectors with infrared proximity sensors, built into a smartwatch prototype to project touch-sensitive icons onto the user's skin.

title: Tag system with low-powered tag and depth sensing camera
summary: A tag system whose small low-power tags switch a PDLC (polymer dispersed liquid crystal) in front of a retroreflector to send an ID, read by the IR emitter of a depth sensing camera that also gives the tag's 3D location.

title: Teegi: tangible EEG interface
summary: Teegi is a tangible EEG interface: a tracked Trexi toy character with the wearer's real-time EEG activity projected onto its head by spatial augmented reality, with mini-Teegi figures selecting EEG filters.

title: Through the combining glass
summary: A design space for planar reflective optical combiners (two-way mirrors) that merge the spaces in front of and behind them, shown with an AR museum cabinet, an AR mirror with an LC sandwich, and an Augmented Musical Instrument with a DepthCube-like volumetric display.

title: Tracs: transparency-control for see-through displays
summary: Tracs: a dual-sided see-through display of two transparent LCDs enclosing a PDLC switchable diffuser transparency-control matrix of 9x6 patches, an ITO LED backlight and a half-wave retardation film.

title: Trampoline: a double-sided elastic touch device for creating reliefs
summary: A double-sided elastic touchpad (Trampoline) made of spandex, magnets and linear hall sensors that senses touch position and force on both sides, used for repoussé-and-chasing relief modeling on virtual surfaces.

title: Vibkinesis: notification by direct tap and 'dying message' using vibronic movement controllable smartphones
summary: Smartphone (Sony Xperia Z) fitted with eight vibration motors that slides and rotates on a table to notify users by direct tap or by changed orientation, even after battery discharge, using an omni-directional lens to find the hand.

title: WirePrint: 3D printed previews for fast prototyping
summary: WirePrint prints low-fidelity wireframe previews on standard FDM 3D printers by extruding filament directly in 3D space along strokes instead of layer-by-layer, giving up to 10x speed-up.

title: WristFlex: low-power gesture input with wrist-worn pressure sensors
summary: A wrist-worn Velcro strap with an array of 15 force sensitive resistors that classifies finger pinch gestures from wrist tendon pressure using a polynomial SVM, running wirelessly in real time at low power.

title: 3D Printed Hair: Fused Deposition Modeling of Soft Strands, Fibers, and Bristles
summary: A technique for fabricating 3D printed hair, fibers and bristles on an unmodified FDM printer by exploiting stringing: extruding small amounts of plastic and quickly drawing the extruder away, with G-code generation and post-processing.

title: BackHand: Sensing Hand Gestures via Back of the Hand
summary: BackHand: an array of 19 strain gauge sensors on a hydrogel-based artificial skin affixed to the back of the hand, with SVM machine learning, recognizing 16 hand gestures from tendon-induced skin deformation.

title: Biometric Touch Sensing: Seamlessly Augmenting Each Touch with Continuous Authentication
summary: Biometric touch sensing lets an unmodified commodity touchscreen identify and authenticate the user on every touch, using the Bioamp wristband that senses wrist bioimpedance and modulates an ID signal through the skin.

title: Candid Interaction: Revealing Hidden Mobile and Wearable Computing Activities
summary: Candid interaction: seven prototypes (Grounding Notifications, Lockscreen Stripes, Semantic Focus, Status Band, Iconic Jewellery with muscle wire, Proxemic AR, Fog Hat) that share mobile and wearable device activity with nearby people.

title: Capricate: A Fabrication Pipeline to Design and 3D Print Capacitive Touch Sensors for Interactive Objects
summary: A fabrication pipeline with a design tool for 3D printing objects with embedded capacitive multi-touch sensors (buttons and grids on flat, ruled and doubly curved surfaces) in one pass using conductive ABS on a multi-material FDM printer.

title: CyclopsRing: Enabling Whole-Hand and Context-Aware Interactions Through a Fisheye Ring
summary: CyclopsRing is a ring-style wearable with a miniature 185-degree fisheye camera worn on the hand webbing, using random decision forest gesture recognition for whole-hand pinch-and-slide, in-air, palm-writing and context-aware input.

title: EM-Sense: Touch Recognition of Uninstrumented, Electrical and Electromechanical Objects
summary: A wrist-worn, modified RTL-SDR software-defined radio receiver with copper-tape armband electrode that classifies body-conducted electromagnetic noise to recognize touched, uninstrumented electrical and electromechanical objects in real time.

title: Encore: 3D Printed Augmentation of Everyday Objects with Printed-Over, Affixed and Interlocked Attachments
summary: Encore is a design tool that analyzes viability, durability and usability to generate 3D printed attachments for everyday objects using print-over, print-to-affix and print-through techniques with printer pausing.

title: FlexiBend: Enabling Interactivity of Multi-Part, Deformable Fabrications Using Single Shape-Sensing Strip
summary: A thin, flexible shape-sensing strip made of a dense linear array of 16 strain gauges on a NinjaFlex base, installed in multi-part or deformable fabrications to sense widget inputs and reconstruct deformable geometry.

title: Foldio: Digital Fabrication of Interactive and Shape-Changing Objects With Foldable Printed Electronics
summary: Foldio is a design and fabrication pipeline that unfolds a 3D Blender model into a print-and-fold pattern with printed conductive-ink touch sensors, fold sensors, electroluminescent displays and shape-memory-polymer actuators for interactive, shape-changing folded objects.

title: FoveAR: Combining an Optically See-Through Near-Eye Display with Projector-Based Spatial Augmented Reality
summary: A hybrid augmented reality display combining a Lumus DK-32 optically see-through near-eye display with a ceiling-mounted Optoma GT760 projector and Kinect v2 for view-dependent projections extending the field of view beyond 100 degrees.

title: GelTouch: Localized Tactile Feedback Through Thin, Programmable Gel
summary: GelTouch: a thin transparent poly(N-isopropylacrylamide) hydrogel layer heated via ITO or resistance wire to switch locally between soft and stiff, giving multi-touch tactile feedback over touchscreens.

title: Gunslinger: Subtle Arms-down Mid-air Interaction
summary: A mid-air barehand interaction technique with two thigh-mounted Leap Motion sensors that recognize finger postures with arms down, shown with hand-cursor feedback and combined with touch input on a large display.

title: HapticPrint: Designing Feel Aesthetics for Digital Fabrication
summary: HapticPrint is a pair of web design tools, an external texture tool and an internal infill-chamber tool, that change the feel (texture, compliance, weight) of FFF 3D printed objects using PLA and NinjaFlex TPE.

title: Impacto: Simulating Physical Impact by Combining Tactile Stimulation with Electrical Muscle Stimulation
summary: Impacto is a wearable bracelet device that renders hitting and being hit in VR by tapping the skin with a solenoid (with exchangeable 3D-printed tips) and thrusting the arm via electrical muscle stimulation.

title: Joint 5D Pen Input for Light Field Displays
summary: Joint 5D pen input for light field displays: a 3D-printed baffled lenslet array shared by four projectors and one IR camera senses an IR LED pen's 3D position and 2D orientation at 150 Hz, with an optional optical relay.

title: Kinetic Blocks: Actuated Constructive Assembly for Interaction and Display
summary: Kinetic Blocks use the inFORM pin-based shape display to assemble, disassemble and reassemble passive wooden and magnetic locking blocks by stacking, scaffolding and catapulting, plus unpowered kinematic blocks (Extender, Hanger, Rotator, Slider) driven and sensed through the pins.

title: LaserStacker: Fabricating 3D Objects by Laser Cutting and Welding
summary: A laser cutter workflow that cuts, welds and heals a stack of acrylic sheets into assembled 3D objects with moving parts, driven by a SketchUp extension that exports cutting, welding and healing instructions.

title: Leveraging Dual-Observable Input for Fine-Grained Thumb Interaction Using Forearm EMG
summary: A forearm-based wearable EMG input system (custom EMG board with dry electrodes) recognizing fine-grained thumb gestures, trained via dual-observable input where Android phone launcher and lock screen gestures label EMG data.

title: LineFORM: Actuated Curve Interfaces for Display, Interaction, and Constraint
summary: LineFORM is an actuated curve interface made of a series chain of 1DOF servo motors with integrated sensors, which displays shapes, senses deformation and touch, and acts as a body or tool constraint.

title: Makers' Marks: Physical Markup for Designing and Fabricating Functional Objects
summary: Makers' Marks lets novices sculpt objects in clay and annotate them with physical stickers, then 3D-scans them and generates mounts for off-the-shelf components to 3D print and assemble functional objects.

title: MoveableMaker: Facilitating the Design, Generation, and Assembly of Moveable Papercraft
summary: A software tool for designing, generating and assembling moveable papercraft (11 effects such as Volvelle, Pull to Translate, Cobweb) that outputs .svg cut blueprints, PDFs and auto-generated assembly instructions for a paper or laser cutter.

title: NanoStylus: Enhancing Input on Ultra-Small Displays with a Finger-Mounted Stylus
summary: NanoStylus: a finger-mounted fine-tip (2mm nib) stylus built from the circuitry of an active capacitive stylus in a custom 3D-printed thimble-shaped housing, with side touch sensor strips, for precise low-occlusion input on smartwatches.

title: Patching Physical Objects
summary: Patching Physical Objects extends a MakerBot Replicator 2X with a mill with suction, a dual-axis rotating platform for 5-axis printing and a depth camera, to mill away and reprint only changed geometry.

title: PERCs: Persistently Trackable Tangibles on Capacitive Multi-Touch Displays
summary: PERCs are persistent capacitive tangibles with an added field sensor, light sensor and BLE link that detect a capacitive touch screen's probing signal so they stay tracked on unmodified multi-touch displays.

title: Printem: Instant Printed Circuit Boards with Standard Office Printers & Inks
summary: Printem film is a five-layer UV-curable copper foil film that lets a standard office inkjet or laser printer print a negative mask, then UV or sunlight exposure and peeling leave a copper PCB.

title: Protopiper: Physically Sketching Room-Sized Objects at Actual Scale
summary: Protopiper is a hand-held, computer-aided fabrication device that forms adhesive tape into hollow tubes with wing connectors and living hinges, letting users physically sketch room-sized objects at actual scale.

title: ReForm: Integrating Physical and Digital Design through Bidirectional Fabrication
summary: ReForm is a bidirectional fabrication system for polymer clay combining a custom five-axis CNC machine with clay extruder and milling spindle, a structured light 3D scanner and projected augmented reality to synchronise a physical object and its digital model.

title: RevoMaker: Enabling Multi-directional and Functionally-embedded 3D printing using a Rotational Cuboidal Platform
summary: RevoMaker modifies an Ultimaker 2 FDM printer with a revolving laser-cut cuboidal platform, printing partitioned geometries around a cuboid that pre-encloses functional components, cutting support material and enabling embedded functional prototypes.

title: Sensing Tablet Grasp + Micro-mobility for Active Reading
summary: A tablet case with a capacitive grip sensor array on its back and edges plus inertial sensors, enclosing an 11.6" Samsung ATIV tablet, with grip-recognition software enabling grasp + micro-mobility techniques for active reading.

title: SensorTape: Modular and Programmable 3D-Aware Dense Sensor Network on a Tape
summary: A cuttable, rejoinable tape of interconnected programmable sensor nodes on flexible electronics with IMUs and time-of-flight proximity sensing, self-configuring network addressing, deformation self-sensing and a graphical programming interface.

title: SmartTokens: Embedding Motion and Grip Sensing in Small Tangible Objects
summary: Coin-sized 3D-printed tangible tokens embedding touch and motion sensing with wireless IEEE 802.15.4 communication, emitting state-machine input events, demonstrated in a tangible notification machine with token dispensers.

title: Tomo: Wearable, Low-Cost Electrical Impedance Tomography for Hand Gesture Recognition
summary: A wearable, low-cost wrist- and armband using Electrical Impedance Tomography between all pairs of eight copper electrodes, with an SVM classifier, to recognize hand gestures in real time.

title: TurkDeck: Physical Virtual Reality Based on People
summary: A prop-based virtual reality system on an Oculus Rift in which human actuators, directed by laser-projected instructions, place and operate generic folding boards and sticks just in time to create arbitrarily large physical-virtual worlds in a small room.

title: uniMorph: Fabricating Thin Film Composites for Shape-Changing Interfaces
summary: A thin-film shape-changing composite of Pyralux flexible copper-clad laminate and UHMW PE, fabricated by printing and etching copper heating patterns, that bends by resistive or environmental heating and supports embedded sensing.

title: A 3D Printer for Interactive Electromagnetic Devices
summary: A low-cost 5DOF FDM delta 3D printer with a rotating dual wire-feeder print head that winds insulated copper coils and soft iron cores in place, printing interactive electromagnetic actuators and sensors.

title: Advancing Hand Gesture Recognition with High Resolution Electrical Impedance Tomography
summary: A low-cost wrist-worn electrical impedance tomography (EIT) system with a 32-electrode leather wristband and custom board, switchable between two-pole and four-pole sensing at 8, 16 and 32 electrodes, for hand gesture recognition.

title: aeroMorph - Heat-sealing Inflatable Shape-change Materials for Interaction Design
summary: aeroMorph is a design, simulation and fabrication pipeline that heat-seals TPU-coated paper, plastic and fabric into inflatable sheets with programmable diamond-hinge bending, made by manual sealing, heat press stencils or a custom CNC sealing head.

title: Aesthetic Electronics: Designing, Sketching, and Fabricating Circuits through Digital Exploration
summary: A pen-and-tablet web design tool for sketching circuits with multiple conductive materials (silver ink, graphite ink, copper tape, conductive thread) that validates them in real time and generates step-by-step fabrication and debugging instructions.

title: AuraSense: Enabling Expressive Around-Smartwatch Interactions with Electric Field Sensing
summary: An off-the-shelf smartwatch augmented with electric field sensing (Microchip MGC3130 chip, one transmitter and four receiver copper-foil electrodes) enabling six around-smartwatch input modalities such as on-skin buttons, sliders, trackpad, radial input and hand gestures.

title: ChainFORM: A Linear Integrated Modular Hardware System for Shape Changing Interfaces
summary: ChainFORM is a linear modular hardware system of identical chained modules, each wrapping a servo motor in a flexible circuit board with touch sensing, angle sensing, LED display and motor actuation, for shape changing interfaces and prototyping tools.

title: Changing the Appearance of Physical Interfaces Through Controlled Transparency
summary: Physical interfaces that change perceived shape through controlled transparency, made by laser cutting, engraving ITO routes into and origami-folding a single sheet of PDLC switchable diffuser, shown as indicators, an avatar and a lamp.

title: CircuitStack: Supporting Rapid Prototyping and Evolution of Electronic Circuits
summary: A hybrid stacked system of a breadboard layer and customized PCBs sandwiching inkjet-printed circuit paper (PCP), connected by contact springs, that converts Fritzing breadboard schematics into reconfigurable, component-reusable circuits.

title: Crowdsourced Fabrication
summary: Intelligent construction space for crowdsourced fabrication of a bamboo tensegrity pavilion: volunteers guided by Apple Watch apps, iBeacon location tracking, wireless RGB LED nodes and UR-10 robot winding stations, coordinated by a foreman engine.

title: Designing a Non-contact Wearable Tactile Display Using Airflows
summary: A non-contact wearable tactile display that delivers airflow from air pumps through 1 mm nozzles (4-point nozzle mount) and micro-fans, with psychophysical thresholds measured on body locations and compared against a vibrotactile display.

title: Digital Gastronomy: Methods & Recipes for Hybrid Cooking
summary: A hybrid kitchen that uses a paste 3D printer, 2.5D milling machines, a laser cutter and a 3D scanner with parametric design to make hybrid recipes such as the Coral Reef Soup and Butterfly Garden meringue.

title: EdgeVib: Effective Alphanumeric Character Output Using a Wrist-Worn Tactile Display
summary: A set of multistroke spatiotemporal vibration patterns (based on EdgeWrite) for delivering alphanumeric characters on a wrist-worn watch-back tactile display built from a 2x2 array of ERM vibration motors.

title: Exploring the Design Space for Energy-Harvesting Situated Displays
summary: A thin, wireless, photovoltaic-powered, energy-neutral situated display using low-resolution segmented or 12x11 dot-matrix electrophoretic e-paper (EPD film) and Bluetooth Low Energy, updating every 1-25 minutes.

title: FaceTouch: Enabling Touch Interaction in Display Fixed UIs for Mobile Virtual Reality
summary: FaceTouch is a multi-touch surface (7 inch capacitive touchpad with pressure-sensing buttons) mounted on the back of an Oculus Rift DK2 HMD, letting users select display-fixed UI content by proprioception.

title: Foundry: Hierarchical Material Design for Multi-Material Fabrication
summary: Foundry is an interactive system for hierarchically designing spatially-varying multi-material objects by composing decomposition, remapping and construct/assign operators into an operator graph, compiled to OpenFL fablets and printed on a Stratasys Connex 500.

title: GyroVR: Simulating Inertia in Virtual Reality using Head Worn Flywheels
summary: GyroVR: head-worn flywheels built from hard drive motors and discs, mounted on a VR headset, that use the gyroscopic effect to render inertia and kinesthetic forces in Virtual Reality.

title: HoloFlex: A Flexible Light-Field Smartphone with a Microlens Array and a P-OLED Touchscreen
summary: HoloFlex is a flexible light-field smartphone with a 16,640-lenslet microlens array over a P-OLED touchscreen that gives glasses-free 3D with motion parallax and stereoscopy, plus bend sensor input for z-axis control.

title: Holoportation: Virtual 3D Teleportation in Real-time
summary: An end-to-end telepresence system using eight custom active-stereo depth camera pods, a two-GPU non-rigid reconstruction pipeline and spatial audio to stream real-time 3D models of people and rooms to remote AR/VR headsets.

title: Immersive Scuba Diving Simulator Using Virtual Reality
summary: Amphibian, a terrestrial VR scuba diving simulator combining a motion platform with torso rest and suspended harness, an Oculus Rift DK2, breath-controlled inflatable cushion, Peltier-cooled gloves and flex/IMU gloves to simulate buoyancy, drag, breathing, temperature and touch.

title: JOLED: A Mid-air Display based on Electrostatic Rotation of Levitated Janus Objects
summary: A mid-air reflective display whose voxels are Janus expanded polystyrene beads with TiO2 dielectric patches, acoustically levitated by 40 kHz ultrasonic transducer arrays and flipped or rotated by high-voltage electrostatic fields from transparent ITO electrodes.

title: LIME: LIquid MEtal Interfaces for Non-Rigid Interaction
summary: LIME, LIquid MEtal interfaces, are cells and widgets (shutter, checkbox, radio button, slider, tactile-texture and weight-changing widgets) that use GaIn25 liquid metal droplets deformed and moved by an electric field in NaOH solution for non-rigid interaction.

title: Metamaterial Mechanisms
summary: Metamaterial mechanisms: single blocks of 3D-printed cell grids using shear cells, hinge arrays and z-cells to perform mechanical functions (door latch, Jansen walker, pliers, pantograph), with a 3D editor that simulates deformation.

title: Mobile Fabrication
summary: Mobile fabrication explored through two surveys and two prototypes, a battery-powered M3D Micro 3D printer and a battery-powered 3Doodler 2.0 extruder pen, each driven by a phone app with a solution database, plus an in-situ metro-train user study.

title: Muscle-plotter: An Interactive System based on Electrical Muscle Stimulation that Produces Spatial Output
summary: Muscle-plotter, a closed-loop electrical muscle stimulation (EMS) system with an Anoto pen on paper that actuates the user's wrist to plot charts, streamlines and widgets as spatial output.

title: NormalTouch and TextureTouch: High-fidelity 3D Haptic Shape Rendering on Handheld Virtual Reality Controllers
summary: NormalTouch (tiltable, extrudable servo-driven platform with force sensor) and TextureTouch (4x4 servo-actuated pin array) are 6 DOF tracked handheld VR controllers that render 3D shape, texture and force to the finger.

title: Phyxel: Realistic Display of Shape and Appearance using Physical Objects with High-speed Pixelated Lighting
summary: Phyxel is a display that synchronizes a rotating disk of physical materials (Phyxel disk with servo motor) with a 1000-fps high-speed projector's pixelated lighting so the naked eye perceives a shape-and-appearance image.

title: proCover: Sensory Augmentation of Prosthetic Limbs Using Smart Textile Covers
summary: A pressure-sensing sock and knee guard made of layered piezoresistive EeonTex and conductive zebra fabric (192-sensor matrix) worn over lower-limb prosthetics, with user-configurable mapping of sensing regions to a vibration-motor armband via a mobile app.

title: RealPen: Providing Realism in Handwriting Tasks on Touch Surfaces using Auditory-Tactile Feedback
summary: RealPen, a 3D-printed augmented stylus with a linear resonant actuator that recreates the tactile friction oscillation and sound of pencil, ballpoint and marker pens on a capacitive tablet screen.

title: Reprise: A Design Tool for Specifying, Generating, and Customizing 3D Printable Adaptations on Everyday Objects
summary: Reprise is a browser-based design tool that lets users specify actions on an object, auto-generates 3D-printable adaptations (wrapper, handle, lever, anchor, guide) with slider customization and a fastening toolkit, validated by replicating 15 examples.

title: Rovables: Miniature On-Body Robots as Mobile Wearables
summary: Rovables are miniature untethered on-body robots with neodymium magnet wheels that climb unmodified clothing and navigate by dead-reckoning from wheel encoders and an IMU, with applications such as tactile feedback, modular displays and motion capture.

title: SkyAnchor: Optical Design for Anchoring Mid-air Images onto Physical Objects
summary: A purely optical retroreflective system of two mirrors and an aerial-imaging plate that anchors mid-air images to physical objects on a capacitive touch table, using object-united pyramid mirror and object-united display rests, with no latency from sensing or actuation.

title: Stretchis: Fabricating Highly Stretchable User Interfaces
summary: Stretchis are highly stretchable, transparent PDMS-based interfaces with screen-printed PEDOT:PSS touch and proximity sensors and electroluminescent displays, made with a multilayer screen-printing method using a binding layer.

title: The Toastboard: Ubiquitous Instrumentation and Automated Checking of Breadboarded Circuits
summary: A ubiquitously instrumented breadboard (Toastboard) that samples every row's voltage through multiplexer cascades, shows connectivity on LED bars, and runs JavaScript component testers in a web client to diagnose circuit errors.

title: TRing: Instant and Customizable Interactions with Objects Using an Embedded Magnet and a Finger-Worn Device
summary: TRing is a finger-worn 9-axis IMU ring that tracks the fingertip in 3D around a small magnet embedded in an object, using a particle filter, plus a magnet placement algorithm and toolkit.

title: ViBand: High-Fidelity Bio-Acoustic Sensing Using Commodity Smartwatch Accelerometers
summary: ViBand boosts the accelerometer sampling of a commodity LG G W100 smartwatch to 4 kHz with a custom kernel driver, enabling bio-acoustic gesture classification, grasped-object recognition and data reception from vibro-tags.

title: WristWhirl: One-handed Continuous Smartwatch Input using Wrist Gestures
summary: A smartwatch strap augmented with 12 infrared proximity sensors and a piezo pinch sensor that tracks the wrist as a joystick, enabling one-handed continuous gesture input on smartwatches.

title: Zooids: Building Blocks for Swarm User Interfaces
summary: Zooids, open-source open-hardware 2.6 cm wheeled micro robots with capacitive touch sensing, tracked by a high-speed DLP structured light projector and a radio base-station, forming tabletop swarm user interfaces.

title: FlexStylus: Leveraging Bend Input for Pen Interaction
summary: A flexible stylus whose barrel deformation, sensed by a cluster of four fibre-optic deformation sensors, gives rotational and absolute bend input for pen interaction techniques such as stroke width, menus and scrolling.

title: iSphere: Self-Luminous Spherical Drone Display
summary: iSphere is a flying spherical display: a quadcopter drone inside a shell, surrounded by eight rotating arcuate multi-LED tapes forming a persistence-of-vision display visible in all directions.

title: Reinventing the Wheel: Transforming Steering Wheel Systems for Autonomous Vehicles
summary: A mechanically transforming robotic steering wheel (four Dynamixel MX-28 actuators, four-bar linkage handles) and a visually transforming LED steering wheel (NeoPixel strip) that alert drivers to transitions of control in autonomous vehicles, evaluated in a driving simulator.

title: 4DMesh: 4D Printing Morphing Non-Developable Mesh Surfaces
summary: 4DMesh: inverse design pipelines (shrinkage actuators with conformal mapping, bending actuators with Chebyshev Net Algorithm) that print flat single-material PLA meshes on an FDM printer which morph into non-developable surfaces in hot water.

title: Assembly-aware Design of Printable Electromechanical Devices
summary: Computational design system that, from a 3D enclosure shape and chosen off-the-shelf electromechanical components, optimizes component layout, mounts, fasteners and collision-free assembly order and paths for a 3D printable enclosure, using a spatio-temporal assembly model.

title: Asterisk and Obelisk: Motion Codes for Passive Tagging
summary: Motion Codes (Asterisk and Obelisk): passive printed stroke patterns that a user traces with a finger wearing a 9-dof IMU ring (BNO055), decoded from directional velocity into encoded data.

title: CamTrackPoint: Camera-Based Pointing Stick Using Transmitted Light through Finger
summary: A 3D-printed black opaque ring suspended on flat springs over a smartphone's front or rear camera bezel works as a pointing stick with force feedback by tracking light transmitted through the finger.

title: Designing Socially Acceptable Hand-to-Face Input
summary: Five design strategies for socially acceptable hand-to-face input from a public elicitation study, instantiated as EarTouch (HMD-mounted Pupil Labs eye camera tracking touches to the ear) and ThumbTouch (a 0.3 mm capacitive thumbnail sensor) for an Epson BT-200 AR HMD.

title: DextrES: Wearable Haptic Feedback for Grasping in VR via a Thin Form-Factor Electrostatic Brake
summary: A thin, light haptic glove with electrostatic brakes of stainless steel strips on the index finger and thumb, 3D printed guides and piezo vibration actuators, giving kinesthetic and cutaneous feedback for grasping in VR.

title: DualPanto: A Haptic Device that Enables Blind Users to Continuously Interact with Virtual Worlds
summary: DualPanto is a haptic device of two spatially registered pantograph force-feedback handles (me and it) that lets blind users continuously track moving objects and play real-time soccer and shooter games.

title: Dynablock: Dynamic 3D Printing for Instant and Reconstructable Shape Formation
summary: Dynamic 3D Printing, realized as Dynablock: a 24 x 16 pin-based shape display with motorized lead-screw pins that acts as a parallel assembler, magnetically connecting 3,000 9 mm blocks into reconstructable 3D shapes in seconds.

title: ElectroTutor: Test-Driven Physical Computing Tutorials
summary: A tutorial system (ElectroTutor) for Arduino physical computing projects that adds interactive software and physical tests to each step, using an Arduino Uno circuit probe device and runtime code instrumentation.

title: FacePush: Introducing Normal Force on Face with Head-Mounted Displays
summary: FacePush is a Vive HMD whose belt is pulled by two motors via 3D-printed clip-on-hinge torque generators in a pulley system, pressing the HMD's face foam to give normal force on the face in VR.

title: FDSense: Estimating Young's Modulus and Stiffness of End Effectors to Facilitate Kinetic Interaction on Touch Surfaces
summary: FDSense estimates the Young's modulus and stiffness of an end effector touching a Sensel Morph touchpad by analyzing measured contact force and contact area with Hertz contact mechanics, demonstrated in digital oil painting and digital drumming applications.

title: GridDrones: A Self-Levitating Physical Voxel Lattice for Interactive 3D Surface Deformations
summary: A self-levitating programmable matter platform of 15 cube-shaped BitDrones nanocopters in a 1xnxn mid-air grid whose voxels are selected by hand and deformed through smartphone-programmed topological relationships to render 2.5D surfaces.

title: Haptic Feedback to the Palm and Fingers for Improved Tactile Perception of Large Objects
summary: A wearable haptic interface gives kinesthetic feedback to thumb, index and middle fingers through a linkage exoskeleton and localized cutaneous feedback to the palm through crank-slider modules, shown to improve size perception of large virtual objects.

title: HydroRing: Supporting Mixed Reality Haptics Using Liquid Flow
summary: HydroRing, a finger-worn mixed-reality haptic device that delivers pressure, vibration and temperature to the fingertip via liquid flow through a thin flexible latex tube fed by a custom hydraulic circuit.

title: I/O Braid: Scalable Touch-Sensitive Lighted Cords Using Spiraling, Repeating Sensing Textiles and Fiber Optics
summary: I/O Braid is a tubular maypole-braided cord of insulated conductive yarns (Helical Sensing Matrix, mutual capacitance) and light-diffusing fiber optics that senses proximity, touch and twist and gives co-located light feedback.

title: Indutivo: Contact-Based, Object-Driven Interactions with Inductive Sensing
summary: Indutivo is a contact-based inductive sensor of five spiral PCB coils read by LDC1614 boards in a smartwatch form factor that recognizes conductive objects and tracks their slide, hinge and rotation.

title: InfiniTouch: Finger-Aware Interaction on Fully Touch Sensitive Smartphones
summary: A full-touch smartphone prototype built from two LG Nexus 5 plus copper-plate edge sensors, with a CNN on capacitive images from front, back and sides that identifies which finger touches and estimates 3D fingertip positions.

title: Magneto-Haptics: Embedding Magnetic Force Feedback for Physical Interactions
summary: Magneto-haptics: a design approach that computes a haptic potential curve from permanent-magnet force distributions using a GPGPU-accelerated modified dipole method, applied to magnet-embedded LEGO blocks, an iPad touch interface and mechanical components.

title: MetaArms: Body Remapping Using Feet-Controlled Artificial Arms
summary: Wearable backpack-mounted anthropomorphic robotic arms with 6 DoF and HACKberry-based hands, controlled by the user's feet via HTC VIVE tracking and toe flex sensors, with motor-driven belt force feedback to the soles.

title: MobiLimb: Augmenting Mobile Devices with a Robotic Limb
summary: MobiLimb is a small 5-DOF serial robotic manipulator built from servo motors that plugs into a smartphone or tablet to add physical deformation input, haptic and expressive output, and modular tips.

title: Orecchio: Extending Body-Language through Actuated Static and Dynamic Auricular Postures
summary: An ear-worn actuated earpiece prototype that uses miniature motors and custom-made robotic arms to stretch and bend the top and side helix of the auricle into static and dynamic postures expressing emotion.

title: PuPoP: Pop-up Prop on Palm for Virtual Reality
summary: A wearable pneumatic shape-proxy interface (Pop-up Prop on Palm) of heat-sealed PE airbags that inflate into sphere, cylinder or box shapes on the palm for grasping virtual objects in VR.

title: RESi: A Highly Flexible, Pressure-Sensitive, Imperceptible Textile Interface Based on Resistive Yarns
summary: RESi is a resistive yarn (copper core with carbon-particle resistive coating) that senses pressure at yarn intersections, usable in hand sewing, machine sewing, embroidery and weaving, with a readout platform and web API.

title: RFIMatch: Distributed Batteryless Near-Field Identification Using RFID-Tagged Magnet-Biased Reed Switches
summary: Modules that connect a magnet-biased reed switch between the chip and antenna of a passive UHF RFID tag so two nearby modules switch off together, giving batteryless near-field identification with haptic feedback, in token and fingerstall forms.

title: RollingStone: Using Single Slip Taxel for Enhancing Active Finger Exploration with a Virtual Reality Controller
summary: A prototype VR controller with a ball-based slip display, a 25.4 mm ball under the index fingertip actuated by two motors in two layers, producing 2-DoF slip feedback for finger sliding and textures.

title: Self-Powered Gesture Recognition with Ambient Light
summary: A self-powered gesture recognition module that uses arrays of photodiodes in photovoltaic mode for both ambient-light energy harvesting and touch and midair finger gesture sensing, built into smart glasses and smartwatch bezel prototypes.

title: Shape-Aware Material: Interactive Fabrication with ShapeMe
summary: A shape-aware material that senses its own geometry as it is cut, using inkjet-printed grids of length-aware capacitive sensors and a toolkit that streams the shape to Blender or Unity 3D models.

title: ShareSpace: Facilitating Shared Use of the Physical Space by both VR Head-Mounted Display and External Users
summary: ShareSpace lets external users place virtual circle and edge shields into a Vive HMD wearer's VR zone using tracked physical shield tools (Vive tracker, LED-matrix display, rotary dial) and an iPad shield visualizer.

title: SilentVoice: Unnoticeable Voice Input by Ingressive Speech
SoundBender: Dynamic Acoustic Control Behind Obstacles
summary: A hybrid sound modulator combining an Ultrahaptics phased array of transducers with a 3D-printed acoustic metamaterial of 16 phase-delay bricks that creates dynamically steerable self-bending beams for levitation and tactile feedback behind obstacles.

title: SynchronizAR: Instant Synchronization for Spontaneous and Spatial Collaborations in Augmented Reality
summary: An approach that spatially registers multiple SLAM-based mobile AR devices (Google Tango phones) using attached Ultra-Wide Bandwidth (UWB) distance measurement modules and a distance-based optimization, without sharing maps or external tracking.

title: Tacttoo: A Thin and Feel-Through Tattoo for On-Skin Tactile Output
summary: Tacttoo: a feel-through rub-on temporary tattoo under 35 micrometres thick with screen-printed Ag/AgCl and PEDOT:PSS micro-spring electrodes that delivers high-density electro-tactile output on skin, with a three-layer electrical safety architecture.

title: Touch+Finger: Extending Touch-based User Interface Capabilities with "Idle" Finger Gestures in the Air
summary: Touch+Finger, a technique that augments touch input on a tablet with 20 hand-pose and in-air gestures of the idle fingers, tracked by two ring-like devices with IMU sensors and classified with a decision tree.

title: TrussFormer: 3D Printing Large Kinetic Structures
summary: An end-to-end editor for designing, animating and 3D printing large kinetic truss structures: it places linear actuators in variable geometry trusses, checks static and dynamic forces by simulation, and generates 3D printable hinging hubs used with PET bottles.

title: Vibrosight: Long-Range Vibrometry for Smart Environment Sensing
summary: A long-range laser vibrometry sensor with a pan-tilt mirror platform that scans for retroreflective tags on objects and classifies their vibration spectrograms to detect appliance use and human activities across a room.

title: VR Grabbers: Ungrounded Haptic Retargeting for Precision Grabbing Tools
summary: Ungrounded Haptic Retargeting with Key State Mapping: a passive chopsticks-shaped VR Grabbers controller with a haptic block, potentiometer and HTC Vive Tracker whose virtual opening angle is retargeted to feel like grabbing virtual objects.

title: Wireless Analytics for 3D Printed Objects
summary: PrintedAnalytics is a circuitless backscatter system for 3D printed objects made of conductive plastic filament, with a bi-directional cantilever switch, interference cancellation for 4 m range, and a ratchet-and-gear store for out-of-range usage data.

title: 3D Printed Fabric: Techniques for Design and 3D Weaving Programmable Textiles
summary: 3D printed fabric: a technique that weaves fibers across rows of thin pillars by controlling the nozzle movement of a consumer-grade FDM 3D printer, with a Rhinoceros/Grasshopper Gcode design tool for programmable textiles.

title: A 3D Printer Head as a Robotic Manipulator
summary: A customized low-cost FDM 3D printer (Creality CR-10) that prints, picks up and drops off printed end-effectors so the printer head acts as a 3-axis robotic manipulator for assembling parts, breaking support materials and actuating printed objects.

title: Accurate and Low-Latency Sensing of Touch Contact on Any Surface with Finger-Worn IMU Sensor
summary: A finger ring with a 9-axis IMU (GY-85) and an SVM classifier senses touch contact on any surface for mixed-reality headsets with 10 ms latency, improving on optical depth-camera touch sensing.

title: ActiTouch: Robust Touch Detection for On-Skin AR/VR Interfaces
summary: A wristband RF emitter plus headset-mounted receiver electrodes that use the body as an RF waveguide to segment on-skin touch, fused with Leap Motion finger tracking for AR/VR on-skin interfaces.

title: Aero-plane: A Handheld Force-Feedback Device that Renders Weight Motion Illusion on a Virtual 2D Plane
summary: A handheld VR force-feedback controller using two miniature jet-propellers (FMS 64mm EDF engines) mounted on a 3D-printed PLA handle that modulate thrust to render a weight motion illusion on a virtual 2D plane.

title: BubBowl: Display Vessel Using Electrolysis Bubbles in Drinkable Beverages
summary: BubBowl is a cup-type liquid-surface display that generates a 10 x 10 pixel dot matrix of electrolysis bubble clusters on beverages using a cathode pin matrix and common anode, with no moving parts.

title: CapstanCrunch: A Haptic VR Controller with User-supplied Force Feedback
summary: A palm-grounded haptic VR controller that uses a friction-based capstan-plus-cord variable-resistance brake, a clutched torsional spring and a twisted-string actuator to render human-scale grasp resistance and compliance up to 20N.

title: DreamWalker: Substituting Real-World Walking Experiences with a Virtual Reality
summary: A mobile VR system that lets users real-walk outdoors while immersed in a pre-authored virtual world, fusing two RealSense RGB depth cameras, Windows Mixed Reality inside-out tracking and GPS to detect obstacles and redirect walking.

title: ElastImpact: 2.5D Multilevel Instant Impact Using Elasticity on Head-Mounted Displays
summary: ElastImpact is a head-mounted-display add-on with two side impactors and a rotatable impactor with proxy collider and barrel that uses elastic bands, DC motors and servo brakes to render 2.5D multilevel instant impact.

title: FaceWidgets: Exploring Tangible Interaction on Face with Head-Mounted Displays
summary: A foldable stepper-motor lift on the back of an Oculus Rift CV1 holds physical controls (button, knob, switch, joystick) at 20 cm from the eyes, with a widget canvas and palm-facing gesture for tangible VR input.

title: GesturePod: Enabling On-device Gesture-based Interaction for White Cane Users
summary: A 49 g clip-on pod for white canes, built from an MPU6050 IMU, Arduino MKR1000 and BLE module, that recognizes five cane gestures on-device with ProtoNN and triggers tasks in an Android app.

title: HapSense: A Soft Haptic I/O Device with Uninterrupted Dual Functionalities of Force Sensing and Vibrotactile Actuation
summary: A single-volume soft haptic I/O device made from a 25-layer screen-printed PVDF ferroelectric polymer stack with a battery-powered high-voltage board that senses force by capacitance while driving vibrotactile actuation.

title: InfoLED: Augmenting LED Indicator Lights for Device Positioning and Communication
summary: A positioning and communication system that overlays high-frequency Manchester-coded brightness flicker on appliance indicator LEDs, read and tracked by a 240 fps smartphone camera app, so AR clients get location, ID and status.

title: Interactive 360-Degree Glasses-Free Tabletop 3D Display
summary: An interactive 360-degree glasses-free tabletop 3D display using 60 projectors with linear blending on a spatially imaged iris plane Fresnel screen, a 360-degree camera with OpenPose for multi-user head tracking, and a tablet for manipulating 3D objects.

title: KnitPicking Textures: Programming and Modifying Complex Knitted Textures for Machine and Hand Knitting
summary: A pipeline that compiles hand-knitting KnitSpeak texture patterns into KnitGraphs, with KnitCarving and KnitPatching algorithms to resize and combine textures, output as machine-knitting (Shima Seiki) or hand-knitting instructions.

title: Knitting Skeletons: A Computer-Aided Design Tool for Shaping and Patterning of Knitted Garments
summary: A browser-based CAD tool that composes parametric knitted primitives (Sheet, Joint, Split) with layered stitch-pattern drawings and a patterning DSL, exporting machine code for whole-garment knitting on a Shima Seiki V-bed machine.

title: LeviProps: Animating Levitated Optimized Fabric Structures using Holographic Acoustic Tweezers
summary: LeviProps are levitated, animatable fabric props made of acoustically transparent Super Organza with attached polystyrene anchor beads, with bead positions optimized by simulated annealing for holographic acoustic tweezers levitators.

title: LightAnchors: Appropriating Point Lights for Spatially-Anchored Augmented Reality Interfaces
summary: LightAnchors blink existing point lights (LEDs, bulbs) at high speed to encode data, which an unmodified iOS smartphone app detects with its high-speed camera to anchor AR interfaces onto objects.

title: M-Hair: Creating Novel Tactile Feedback by Augmenting the Body Hair to Respond to Magnetic Field
summary: M-Hair: body hair coated with passive magnetic cosmetics (iron-particle face mask mixed into hair wax) is actuated by an external magnetic field, from a rare-earth magnet moved by a modified laser engraver, to give non-contact tactile feedback.

title: Mantis: A Scalable, Lightweight and Accessible Architecture to Build Multiform Force Feedback Systems
summary: An open-source, scalable architecture for multiform 3D force feedback arms using low-cost brushless DC motors, a custom controller, a self-built three-axis force sensor and admittance control, shown in five devices.

title: Masque: Exploring Lateral Skin Stretch Feedback on the Face with Head-Mounted Displays
summary: A prototype HTC Vive Pro head-mounted display with six 2-DOF motor-driven shear tactors on its facial interface that produce lateral skin stretch feedback on the face in VR.

title: MeCap: Whole-Body Digitization for Low-Cost VR/AR Headsets
summary: A sub-$5 accessory of two cantilevered hemispherical chrome mirrors viewed by a smartphone's rear camera on low-cost VR/AR headsets, enabling whole-body, hand, mouth, apparel and environment capture via unwarping, OpenPose and stereo reverse raycasting.

title: milliMorph -- Fluid-Driven Thin Film Shape-Change Materials for Interaction Design
summary: milliMorph is a design space and Non-contact Hot Air Sealing (NoHAS) CNC platform for fabricating millimeter-scale fluid chambers and channels in thin PET/Mylar film, giving fluid-driven shape-change films for haptics, ambient devices and robotics.

title: Morphlour: Personalized Flour-based Morphing Food Induced by Dehydration or Hydration Method
summary: Morphlour makes flour-based dough morph into folded or coiled shapes during baking (dehydration) or boiling (hydration) through groove-induced differential shrinking or swelling, with a computational design tool and CNC grooving platform.

title: Multi-Touch Kit: A Do-It-Yourself Technique for Capacitive Multi-Touch Sensing Using a Commodity Microcontroller
summary: A do-it-yourself technique for mutual-capacitance multi-touch sensing on custom sensor matrices using a commodity Arduino, a multiplexer and resistors, with 4 MHz PWM transmit signals and the Arduino's built-in ADC as filter.

title: Ohmic-Sticker: Force-to-Motion Type Input Device that Extends Capacitive Touch Surface
summary: Ohmic-Sticker is a thin, battery-less force-to-motion input device built from an FSR film on a comb-electrode PCB that attaches to commercial capacitive touch surfaces and is read as shunting current via Ohmic-Touch.

title: Ondulé: Designing and Controlling 3D Printable Springs
summary: An interactive Rhino design tool that converts selected 3D-model geometry into parameterizable FDM-printable helical springs with embedded prismatic, revolute, knuckle, cylindrical and ball joints, supporting compress, extend, twist and bend behaviors.

title: Opisthenar: Hand Poses and Finger Tapping Recognition by Observing Back of Hand Using Embedded Wrist Camera
summary: A vision-based technique using a wrist-worn infrared camera (re-purposed Leap Motion) observing the opisthenar (back of the hand) with deep neural networks to recognize static hand poses and dynamic finger tapping gestures.

title: Photo-Chromeleon: Re-Programmable Multi-Color Textures Using Photochromic Dyes
summary: Photo-Chromeleon is a re-programmable multi-color texture method that mixes cyan, magenta and yellow photochromic dyes into one airbrushed coating and controls each channel with UV light and a modified LED DLP projector.

title: Proxino: Enabling Prototyping of Virtual Circuits with Physical Proxies
summary: Proxino is a circuit prototyping environment in which real I/O components act as physical proxies for virtual breadboard circuits in Fritzing, via a custom Arduino UNO shield and a LiveSpice-based simulator, supporting remote collaboration.

title: PseudoBend: Producing Haptic Illusions of Stretching, Bending, and Twisting Using Grain Vibrations
summary: PseudoBend is a haptic technique that renders grain vibrations from a voice coil actuator, driven by a single 6-DOF force/torque sensor, to make a rigid two-handle device feel like it is stretching, bending, or twisting.

title: Pull-Ups: Enhancing Suspension Activities in Virtual Reality with Body-Scale Kinesthetic Force Feedback
summary: A TRX-style indoor suspension exercise kit whose two straps are replaced by groups of three pneumatic artificial muscles (air muscles), actuating a VR user's body up to 15 cm via the hands to give kinesthetic force feedback in kitesurfing, paragliding and space invader games.

title: RFTouchPads: Batteryless and Wireless Modular Touch Sensor Pads Based on RFID
summary: RFTouchPads are batteryless wireless 3x3 touch sensor pads (flexible StickerPad and tileable TilePad) made by connecting multiple UHF RFID chips in parallel to one antenna, read by an RFID reader.

title: Robiot: A Design Tool for Actuating Everyday Objects with Automatically Generated 3D Printable Mechanisms
summary: Robiot is a design-by-demonstration tool that analyzes a user's video of manipulating an everyday object and automatically generates 3D printable gear-rack, four-bar linkage or pin-in-slot actuation mechanisms to motorize it.

title: SCALE: Enhancing Force-based Interaction by Processing Load Data from Load Sensitive Modules
summary: A prototyping toolkit of modular load sensitive modules (three-axis load cells with a Teensy 3.6 controller) and a load data processing framework giving 3D touch detection, object status tracking and motion pattern recognition.

title: Self-healing UI: Mechanically and Electrically Self-healing Materials for Sensing and Actuation Interfaces
summary: Self-healing UI is a soft-bodied interface built by layer-by-layer stacking of self-healing polyborosiloxane (PBS) and conductive MWCNTs-PBS with silicone and fabric, giving mechanical and electrical self-healing sensing and actuation devices.

title: SensorSnaps: Integrating Wireless Sensor Nodes into Fabric Snap Fasteners for Textile Interfaces
summary: SensorSnaps are low-power wireless BLE sensor nodes with a 9-axis IMU in 3D-printed caps that screw onto off-the-shelf plastic snap fasteners, detecting tap, rotation and capacitive touch gestures and body motion on clothing.

title: ShapeBots: Shape-changing Swarm Robots
summary: Shape-changing swarm robots: tabletop wheeled robots, each with miniature reel-based linear actuators extending 2.5 cm to 20 cm, tracked with ArUco markers, that collectively and individually transform to display shapes and data.

title: Skin-On Interfaces: A Bio-Driven Approach for Artificial Skin Design to Cover Interactive Devices
summary: Skin-On interfaces: silicone artificial skin (epidermis, dermis with embedded conductive-thread mutual-capacitance electrodes, Ecoflex Gel hypodermis) covering smartphones, touchpads and wristbands to sense skin-like gestures such as pinch, stroke and grab.

title: Soft Inkjet Circuits: Rapid Multi-Material Fabrication of Soft Circuits using a Commodity Inkjet Printer
summary: Soft Inkjet Circuits prints stretchable, ultrathin, multi-material circuits (silver, PEDOT:PSS, PVP inks) on TPU, tattoo paper, textile transfer film and shrink film using a commodity Epson inkjet printer.

title: Sozu: Self-Powered Radio Tags for Building-Scale Activity Sensing
summary: Battery-free analog radio tags that convert energy harvested from sensed activities (motion, vibration, light, heat, EM, gas and water flow) into 35-85 MHz RF broadcasts, received building-wide by one software defined radio antenna for activity sensing.

title: SpringFit: Joints and Mounts that Fabricate on Any Laser Cutter
summary: A web-based software tool that converts 2D SVG cutting plans by replacing press-fit mounts, notch, finger and t-joints with cantilever spring-based ones, so models fabricate on any laser cutter and material.

title: StackMold: Rapid Prototyping of Functional Multi-Material Objects with Selective Levels of Surface Details
summary: A DIY multi-stage molding technique that casts multi-material, multi-color objects with embedded electronics in laser-cut sliced molds with optional 3D-printed high-detail subsections, with algorithms for cast sequences and instructions.

title: StateLens: A Reverse Engineering Solution for Making Existing Dynamic Touchscreens Accessible
summary: A system that reverse engineers state diagrams of dynamic touchscreens from point-of-view videos with a hybrid crowd-computer vision pipeline, gives blind users conversational agent and iOS app guidance, and adds 3D-printed finger cap and conductive stylus accessories for risk-free exploration.

title: SWISH: A Shifting-Weight Interface of Simulated Hydrodynamics for Haptic Perception of Virtual Fluid Vessels
summary: SWISH is an ungrounded handheld 3D printed bucket with a motorized rack-and-pinion mechanism that shifts a weighted mass to move its center of gravity, haptically simulating NVIDIA Flex virtual fluid in VR.

title: Tactlets: Adding Tactile Feedback to 3D Objects Using Custom Printed Controls
summary: Tactlets is a digital design and printing approach, using a Rhino3D plug-in and conductive inkjet or conductive-filament 3D printing, for custom electro-tactile controls with resistive touch sensing on 3D objects.

title: Tessutivo: Contextual Interactions on Interactive Fabrics with Inductive Sensing
summary: A contact-based inductive sensing technique for interactive fabrics: a 6x6 grid of spiral coils of conductive thread sewn onto a four-layer fabric recognizes conductive objects like keys and coins with 93.9% accuracy.

title: Third-Person Piloting: Increasing Situational Awareness using a Spatially Coupled Second Drone
summary: Third-Person Piloting, a drone interface where a second 3DR Solo drone is spatially coupled to the pilot-controlled primary drone via a rotatable drone-shaped miniature on the controller, giving an interactive third-person view.

title: TilePoP: Tile-type Pop-up Prop for Virtual Reality
summary: A floor-mounted 3x3 array of stacked, spiral-folding cube airbags pneumatically inflated into body-scale pop-up props that give whole-body haptic feedback and support body weight for VR interactions.

title: Tip-Tap: Battery-free Discrete 2D Fingertip Input
summary: A battery-free wearable fingertip input technique detecting 2D discrete thumb-to-index touches via two contact arrays and a custom multi-chip RFID tag with two half-antennas, built as a glove and on-skin tattoo.

title: Turn-by-Wire: Computationally Mediated Physical Fabrication
summary: Turn-by-Wire couples a custom desktop CNC lathe with two drive-by-wire force-feedback handwheels and a web GUI so users cut by hand while software renders haptic cutting forces, guides, limit stops and technique scaffolding.

title: AAR: Augmenting a Wearable Augmented Reality Display with an Actuated Head-Mounted Projector
summary: Augmented Augmented Reality combines a Microsoft HoloLens V1 AR headset with a servo pan-tilt actuated head-mounted Celluon PicoBit pico projector, calibrated by a modified structure from motion pipeline and driven by an open-source Unity3D toolkit.

title: Acustico: Surface Tap Detection and Localization using Wrist-based Acoustic TDOA Sensing
summary: A wristband prototype with two accelerometers and two microphones detects taps and localizes them in 2D on uninstrumented surfaces using acoustic time differences of arrival (TDOA) between surface waves and sound waves.

title: Back-Hand-Pose: 3D Hand Pose Estimation for a Wrist-worn Camera via Dorsum Deformation Network
summary: A wrist-worn USB fisheye RGB camera viewing the back of the hand, with DorsalNet, a two-stream ResNet18 LSTM-Kalman-filter network on masked hand and motion history images, regressing 3D finger joint angles in real time.

title: bARefoot: Generating Virtual Materials using Motion Coupled Vibration in Shoes
summary: A sandal-based haptic shoe (bARefoot) with pressure-sensitive sole, IMU and Taptic Engines that couples vibration grains to foot motion to render virtual materials, plus the vibrAteRial design tool.

title: BodyPrinter: Fabricating Circuits Directly on the Skin at Arbitrary Locations Using a Wearable Compact Plotter
summary: BodyPrinter is a compact wearable three-axis plotter with a syringe ink extruder that straps to the body and prints skin-safe Bare Conductive ink circuits directly on skin at arbitrary locations after z-axis calibration.

title: C-Face: Continuously Reconstructing Facial Expressions by Deep Learning Contours of the Face with Ear-mounted Miniature Cameras
summary: C-Face is an ear-mounted wearable, built into headphones and earphones with two miniature RGB cameras, that feeds facial contour images to a ResNet-18 deep learning model to continuously output 42 facial feature points.

title: Capacitivo: Contact-Based Object Recognition on Interactive Fabrics using Capacitive Sensing
summary: Capacitivo: a 12x12 conductive-fabric electrode grid on a textile substrate that recognizes non-metallic objects (food, liquids, daily items) by their capacitance footprint using resonance-based self/mutual capacitive sensing and Random Forest.

title: CoVR: A Large-Scale Force-Feedback Robotic Interface for Non-Deterministic Scenarios in VR
summary: A physical column mounted on a 2D Cartesian ceiling robot (XY pulley-belt gantry) that moves interchangeable panels and props to provide strong kinesthetic feedback (>100 N), pulling or transporting users, steered by a user intention model using only HMD pose.

title: DeepFisheye: Near-Surface Multi-Finger Tracking Technology Using Fisheye Camera
summary: DeepFisheye tracks 3D fingertip positions near a touchscreen from a 220-degree fisheye camera at the bottom of a Microsoft Surface, using DeepFisheyeNet deep learning trained on new synthetic and real fisheye hand datasets, plus rule-based contact finger and hand posture classifiers.

title: DefeXtiles: 3D Printing Quasi-Woven Fabric via Under-Extrusion
summary: DefeXtiles prints tulle-like quasi-woven fabrics on unmodified FDM printers by deliberately under-extruding filament (glob-stretch printing, low extrusion multiplier), with patterning, conductive PLA sensing and several textile applications.

title: E-seed: Shape-Changing Interfaces that Self Drill
summary: E-seed is a biomimetic, Erodium-seed-inspired self-drilling platform made from caustic-soda-softened wood veneer coil with flour-dough hairy tip that drills into soil by harvesting moisture fluctuations, carrying sensors and displays.

title: ElaStick: A Handheld Variable Stiffness Display for Rendering Dynamic Haptic Response of Flexible Object
summary: ElaStick is a handheld VR controller with a quaternion joint and four tendons of adjustable stiffness, made by winding elastic and inelastic wire on spools, that renders the dynamic response of swung flexible objects in 2-DoF.

title: ElastiLinks: Force Feedback between VR Controllers with Dynamic Points of Application of Force
summary: Handheld VR controllers (ElastiLinks) joined by an elastic-band resistive force link and an impact link, each attached to a motor-rotated track with a motor-driven connector giving a dynamic point of application of force.

title: FS-Pad: Video Game Interactions Using Force Feedback Gamepad
summary: A force-feedback gamepad built by fitting a 2-axis motor-driven FS module (gimbal thumbstick with coreless motors and a Teensy forcemap controller) into an Xbox One controller housing, supporting five game interaction themes.

title: HandMorph: a Passive Exoskeleton that Miniaturizes Grasp
summary: A passive exoskeleton of four-bar mechanical links that transmits the wearer's finger motion and haptic feedback to a smaller hand of five silicone-coated rubber fingers, miniaturizing grasp range.

title: HapLinkage: Prototyping Haptic Proxies for Virtual Hand Tools Using Linkage Mechanism
summary: A prototyping framework using four-bar and six-bar linkage structure templates, 3D-printed rods with snap-fit joints, a servo-and-encoder actuating module and a FreeCAD plug-in to build haptic proxies of virtual hand tools for VR.

title: Haptic PIVOT: On-Demand Handhelds in VR
summary: A wrist-worn haptic device with a single servo-actuated pivoting handle that moves into and out of the user's palm on demand to render grasping, catching, throwing and dynamic forces of virtual objects in VR.

title: Haptics with Input: Back-EMF in Linear Resonant Actuators to Enable Touch, Pressure and Environmental Awareness
summary: Back-EMF sensing in off-the-shelf linear resonant actuators (LRAs) enables active touch and pressure sensing and passive low-power tap sensing, demonstrated on phone side buttons, a tactile bracelet and a phone's own LRA.

title: HERMITS: Dynamically Reconfiguring the Interactivity of Self-propelled TUIs with Mechanical Shell Add-ons
summary: HERMITS are passive mechanical shell add-ons (3D printed, with transmission mechanisms and optical paths) that modified two-wheeled toio robots with an active docking pin dock into and detach from, dynamically reconfiguring the robots' shape, motion, light and input.

title: HMD Light: Sharing In-VR Experience via Head-Mounted Projector for Asymmetric Interaction
summary: A head-mounted projector add-on for an Oculus Rift S (HMD Light): a servo-mounted projector and depth camera pro-cam unit projects the VR user's experience onto the floor, with foot-touch input for external users.

title: Kerf-Canceling Mechanisms: Making Laser-Cut Mechanisms Operate across Different Laser Cutters
summary: Kerf-canceling mechanisms are laser-cut bearings, sliders and gear pairs with an added wedge inset that keeps them working across laser cutters with different kerf, plus the KerfCanceler tool that converts SVG cutting plans.

title: KnitGIST: A Programming Synthesis Toolkit for Generating Functional Machine-Knitting Textures
summary: A program synthesis pipeline and library that generates machine-knittable KnitSpeak texture programs by mapping objectives to tactics, producing functional knit textures such as welts, lace hexagons and a lampshade.

title: LamiFold: Fabricating Objects with Integrated Mechanisms Using a Laser cutter Lamination Workflow
summary: LamiFold is a Fusion 360 plugin and laser cutter sheet lamination workflow (selective cutting and gluing of stacked sheets) that fabricates foldable objects with embedded rotary, linear, hinge, detent, ratchet and locking mechanisms without off-the-shelf parts.

title: MechanoBeat: Monitoring Interactions with Everyday Objects using 3D Printed Harmonic Oscillators and Ultra-Wideband Radar
summary: 3D printed electronics-free harmonic oscillator tags (pendulum, spring-mass, tourbillon) that oscillate at unique frequencies upon object interaction, detected through walls by a PulsON 440 ultra-wideband radar array and a 1D CNN.

title: MonoEye: Multimodal Human Motion Capture System Using A Single Ultra-Wide Fisheye Camera
summary: A chest-worn single ultra-wide fisheye camera (GoPro Hero 7 Black with Entaniya M12-280 lens) whose images feed BodyPoseNet, HeadPoseNet and CameraPoseNet to capture 3D body pose, head pose, camera pose and viewport.

title: MorphSensor: A 3D Electronic Design Tool for Reforming Sensor Modules
summary: A 3D electronic design tool, a Grasshopper plugin for Rhino3D, that morphs existing SparkFun sensor module schematics into free-form component layouts on a 3D prototype and fabricates them with pre-fabricated BigFoot PCB footprints and silver inkjet printing.

title: OddEyeCam: A Sensing Technique for Body-Centric Peephole Interaction Using WFoV RGB and NFoV Depth Cameras
summary: A vision-based method that tracks a smartphone's 3D position relative to the user's body by combining a wide-field-of-view fisheye RGB camera for OpenPose body keypoints with a narrow-field-of-view Intel RealSense D415 depth camera, enabling body-centric peephole interaction.

title: Omni: Volumetric Sensing and Actuation of Passive Magnetic Tools for Dynamic Haptic Feedback
summary: A self-contained haptic base combining a 3 DoF spherical electromagnet with eight Hall sensors and a gradient-based position reconstruction to simultaneously sense and actuate a passive handheld tool containing a small permanent magnet.

title: Optimal Control for Electromagnetic Haptic Guidance Systems
summary: An MPCC-based optimal control scheme with a real-time dipole force model guides a magnet-tipped pen via an electromagnet on a bi-axial linear stage under the drawing surface, letting users override guidance.

title: poimo: Portable and Inflatable Mobility Devices Customizable for Personal Physical Characteristics
summary: poimo: portable inflatable personal mobility devices (motorcycle and wheelchair) with inflatable frames, wheels and steering hinge made of drop-stitch fabric, plus a Kinect-based posture-scanning design tool that customizes the vehicle to the rider.

title: Polymorphic Blocks: Unifying High-level Specification and Low-level Control for Circuit Board Design
summary: Polymorphic Blocks is a Python-embedded hardware description language with generators, polymorphic block classes, an electronics model and a block diagram refinement GUI that produces KiCad netlists for circuit board design.

title: Pop-up Print: Rapidly 3D Printing Mechanically Reversible Objects in the Folded State
summary: Pop-up Print is a method and web-based interactive design tool for 3D printing mechanically bistable objects in a folded state (mirror-reflection planar folding with soft-material hinges) on a multi-material printer, then unfolding them.

title: Programmable Filament: Printed Filaments for Multi-material 3D Printing
summary: Programmable Filament prints spliced multi-segment filaments on an unmodified single-nozzle FDM printer via G-code, then uses them as regular filament for multi-color and multi-material prints, with Rhinoceros/Grasshopper design software.

title: REACH+: Extending the Reachability of Encountered-type Haptics Devices through Dynamic Redirection in VR
summary: A framework for dynamic visuo-haptic reach redirection that predicts the user's target and arrival time and redirects the hand to a point reachable by an encountered-type haptic device, tested with a custom desktop omnidirectional mobile robot.

title: Romeo: A Design Tool for Embedding Transformable Parts in 3D Models to Robotically Augment Default Functionalities
summary: A 3D-model design tool that lets users select a transformable part, specify motion points and actions, and automatically generates a 3D-printable robotic arm embedded in the object to augment its default functionality.

title: SchemaBoard: Supporting Correct Assembly of Schematic Circuits using Dynamic In-Situ Visualization
summary: An LED-backlit solderless mini breadboard with one addressable blue LED under each row, controlled from a tablet schematic app, that lights rows for components and nets so makers can assemble and inspect circuits from schematics.

title: ShARe: Enabling Co-Located Asymmetric Multi-User Interaction for Augmented Reality Head-Mounted Displays
summary: A first-generation Microsoft HoloLens augmented with a head-mounted Optoma ML750e projector tilted by a servo motor projects aligned AR content onto planar surfaces so non-HMD users can see it and interact via ArUco marker finger tracking.

title: SimuLearn: Fast and Accurate Simulator to Support Morphing Materials Design and Workflows
summary: A data-driven simulator combining finite element analysis and a graph convolutional network that predicts 4D printed PLA 2x2 grid transformations in real time, used in Rhinoceros/Grasshopper forward, inverse and hybrid design tools.

title: Sonoflex: Embroidered Speakers Without Permanent Magnets
summary: An embroidered dynamic speaker without permanent magnets, made of two stacked flat spiral coils of 0.15 mm enameled Cu/Ag20 Textile Wire embroidered on fabric, driven by a voice coil signal and a rectified bias coil.

title: Taste Display that Reproduces Tastes Measured by a Taste Sensor
summary: A taste display that uses iontophoresis on five electrolyte gels plus a tasteless gel to reproduce tastes measured by taste sensors, calibrated to sensor values and paired with taste-editing video software, effects and an equalizer.

title: TelemetRing: A Batteryless and Wireless Ring-shaped Keyboard using Passive Inductive Telemetry
summary: A batteryless, wireless ring-shaped keyboard of five sensor-coil rings (piezoelectric accelerometer plus varactor diode) whose typing shocks shift resonant frequency, read by a wrist-mounted readout coil via passive inductive telemetry.

title: Tsugite: Interactive Design and Fabrication of Wood Joints
summary: An interactive voxel-based design system for wood joints in frame structures, with real-time feedback, suggestions and a gallery of pre-computed joints, plus a corner-rounding path planner for 3-axis CNC milling.

title: Wearable Subtitles: Augmenting Spoken Communication with Lightweight Eyewear for All-day Captioning
summary: Wearable Subtitles is a lightweight (54 g) 3D-printed head-worn display eyewear with a low-power thin-client architecture paired with an Android phone over BLE, giving deaf and hard-of-hearing users up to 15 hours of captioning.

title: WIKA: A Projected Augmented Reality Workbench for Interactive Kinetic Art
summary: A projected AR workbench using AR-marker plates, a projector, camera and mobile device that lets non-experts program, simulate and build interactive kinetic picture frames with sensors and motors.

title: ZebraSense: A Double-sided Textile Touch Sensor for Smart Clothing
summary: ZebraSense is a dual-sided woven textile capacitive touch sensor, made with multi-layer weaving of even and odd conductive yarns, that recognizes multi-touch gestures and which side (top or bottom) is touched.

title: ZoomWalls: Dynamic Walls that Simulate Haptic Infrastructure for Room-scale VR World
summary: Autonomous wheeled robotic encounter-type haptic wall-shaped props (ZoomWalls, foam core boards on Roomba robots) that a predict-and-dispatch server coordinates to provide just-in-time haptic walls and doors in room-scale VR.

title: Adroid: Augmenting Hands-on Making with a Collaborative Robot
summary: Adroid mounts hand-held tools (measurement probe, track, drill, camera) on a Kuka industrial robot with a custom low-cost force-torque sensor so users move tools by hand while the robot enforces virtual jig constraints, with projection AR feedback.

title: AirConstellations: In-Air Device Formations for Cross-Device Interaction via Multiple Spatially-Aware Armatures
summary: AirConstellations: off-the-shelf 3-joint flexible tablet mounting arms retrofitted with IMUs and Bourns 3510 rotation sensors to track 7DoF in-air formations of attached tablets, driving cross-device interaction techniques via a C# prototyping tool.

title: Altering Perceived Softness of Real Rigid Objects by Restricting Fingerpad Deformation
summary: A finger-worn haptic device with a motor-pulled hollow frame that restricts fingerpad deformation, making real rigid objects feel softer while leaving the fingerpad center free.

title: Chemical Haptics: Rendering Haptic Sensations via Topical Stimulants
summary: Chemical Haptics: a self-contained wearable soft silicone patch with open channels and MP6 piezoelectric micropumps that circulates topical stimulants (sanshool, lidocaine, cinnamaldehyde, capsaicin, menthol) over skin to render tingling, numbing, stinging, warming and cooling in VR.

title: Daedalus in the Dark: Designing for Non-Visual Accessible Construction of Laser-Cut Architecture
summary: A generative design add-in for Autodesk Fusion 360 that automatically produces tactile aids (entry-component circle, engraved arrows and lines, half-circle hollows, rastered guide tracks, ground support, spatial layout) on laser-cut plates so blind or low-vision people can assemble laser-cut models.

title: DextrEMS: Increasing Dexterity in Electrical Muscle Stimulation by Combining it with Brakes
summary: DextrEMS is a 68g untethered glove that pairs electrical muscle stimulation with a motor-driven ratchet-and-pawl brake on eight finger joints, giving independent, oscillation-free finger poses.

title: EIT-kit: An Electrical Impedance Tomography Toolkit for Health and Motion Sensing
summary: EIT-kit is an electrical impedance tomography toolkit with a Rhino3D/Grasshopper 3D editor plugin for electrode arrays, a custom ESP32-based EIT sensing motherboard with mux boards, an Arduino microcontroller library, and an iOS image reconstruction API for health and motion sensing devices.

title: FabHydro: Printing Interactive Hydraulic Devices with an Affordable SLA 3D Printer
summary: FabHydro prints interactive hydraulic devices (bellows generators, tubing, switches and bending/straightening/extending/curling actuators) with an off-the-shelf SLA printer and flexible resin, sealing fluid by Submerged Printing or Printing with Plugs.

title: HapticBots: Distributed Encountered-type Haptics for VR with Multiple Shape-changing Mobile Robots
summary: HapticBots are encountered-type VR haptic devices: multiple Sony Toio mobile robots fitted with custom reel-based height-changing and tilting actuators that move to meet the user's hand and render surfaces.

title: HoloBoard: a Large-format Immersive Teaching Board based on pseudo HoloGraphics
summary: A 4m x 3m translucent projected screen with SteamVR 2.0 base stations, HTC Vive controllers and VIVE trackers and Unity rendering gives a large-format pseudo-holographic transparent teaching board for lecture-based classes.

title: Identifying Contact Fingers on Touch Sensitive Surfaces by Ring-Based Vibratory Communication
summary: Two ring-shaped vibration transmitters (surface transducers in flexible Tango Plus rings) send on-off keying sequences with per-finger carrier frequencies to a tablet microphone, demodulated by cross-correlation to identify contact fingers.

title: Lenticular Objects: 3D Printed Objects with Lenticular Lens Surfaces That Can Change their Appearance Depending on the Viewpoint
