summary: 3D printed lenticular objects: spherical lenticular lenses and underlying color patterns printed in one pass on a multi-material Stratasys J55 PolyJet printer over curved surfaces, with a Rhino3D/Grasshopper editor so objects show different appearances from different viewpoints.

title: MARS: Nano-Power Battery-free Wireless Interfaces for Touch, Swipe and Speech Input
summary: MARS (Multichannel Ambiently-powered Realtime Sensing) is a battery-free sticker tag that senses touch, swipe and speech by combining a nanowatt Modified Clapp Oscillator built on a zero-Vth FET with frequency-shifted analog backscatter, powered by photodiodes or a thermoelectric generator.

title: MetaSense: Integrating Sensing Capabilities into Mechanical Metamaterial
summary: A design and fabrication pipeline that turns selected opposing cell walls of 3D-printable mechanical metamaterial into conductive shear cells for capacitive sensing, with a 3D editor that auto-places them and exports files for multi-material printing.

title: Midair Balloon Interface: A Soft and Lightweight Midair Object for Proximate Interactions
summary: A midair balloon interface: a helium-filled balloon propelled in 3D by airborne ultrasound phased arrays (AUTD3) and tracked by high-speed stereo cameras, supporting sight-based and touch-based interaction with vibrotactile feedback via amplitude-modulated ultrasound.

title: ModularHMD: A Reconfigurable Mobile Head-Mounted Display Enabling Ad-hoc Peripheral Interactions with the Real World
summary: A reconfigurable mobile head-mounted display with a central VRM-100 screen and three removable iPod Touch modules in sliding holders on the cowl, switchable between occluding, extended VR view, video see-through and removed/reused as an interaction device.

title: MoiréBoard: A Stable, Accurate and Low-cost Camera Tracking Method
summary: MoiréBoard is a passive, calibration-free 3-DOF camera position tracking method that uses the moiré fringes of a 3D-printed grating layer over a base grating and a tracking formula, running on a stock iPhone.

title: MotionRing: Creating Illusory Tactile Motion around the Head using 360° Vibrotactile Headbands
summary: A vibrotactile elastic headband (MotionRing) with 12 or 16 Linear Resonance Actuators whose timing creates 360-degree apparent tactile motion around the head, applied to VR teleportation and football dodging.

title: OmniFiber: Integrated Fluidic Fiber Actuators for Weaving Movement based Interactions into the ‘Fabric of Everyday Life’
summary: OmniFiber is a soft, line-based material system of thin (under 1.8 mm) fluidic fiber actuators with integrated airbrushed carbon black strain sensors, fabricated off-the-shelf and controlled by an extended FlowIO platform for movement-based interactions in textiles.

title: Per Garment Capture and Synthesis for Real-time Virtual Try-on
summary: A per-garment workflow for real-time virtual try-on: an actuated mannequin captures RGBD images of each garment, and a pix2pixHD image-to-image network maps a color-coded measurement garment worn by the customer to the target garment.

title: PneuSeries: 3D Shape Forming with Modularized Serial-Connected Inflatables
summary: Modularized inflatables made of heat-sealed PE sheet, connected in series through self-made bidirectional ball check valve connectors so one pump's sequential push/pull programs 3D shape forming.

title: PocketView: Through-Fabric Information Displays
summary: PocketView: through-fabric information displays that shine bright 8x8 RGBW LED matrix displays (in phone-case, wallet, key fob, pen and earbud case form factors) through pocket fabric to show smartphone notifications and directions.

title: Roadkill: Nesting Laser-Cut Objects for Fast Assembly
summary: Roadkill is a software tool that converts 3D models into 2D laser-cutting plans using subassemblies, break-away tabs, adjacency, arrows, thumbnails and jigs so that laser-cut plate objects assemble 2.4 times faster.

title: SensiCut: Material-Aware Laser Cutting Using Speckle Sensing and Deep Learning
summary: A speckle sensing add-on (green laser pointer and lensless image sensor) for laser cutters that identifies 30 sheet materials with a ResNet-50 CNN and a web interface that sets power/speed, warns about hazardous materials, adjusts kerf and splits multi-material designs.

title: STRIVE: String-Based Force Feedback for Automotive Engineering
summary: STRIVE is a wireless string-based force feedback device (reel with mainspring, ratchet gear blocked by a solenoid, Arduino Nano, 3D-printed PLA box) mountable on body or objects, built via participatory design with automotive VR engineers.

title: Trusscillator: a System for Fabricating Human-Scale Human-Powered Oscillating Devices
summary: Trusscillator is an end-to-end system for designing and fabricating human-scale, human-powered oscillating devices from welded steel trusses with coil springs, tuned for motion range, tempo and effort, with stencils and temporary connectors for welding.

title: TypeBoard: Identifying Unintentional Touch on Pressure-Sensitive Touchscreen Keyboards
summary: A pressure-sensitive touchscreen keyboard (TypeBoard) that uses an SVM on pressure, contact area and touch-history features to reject unintentional touches such as resting fingers, letting users rest hands and, with sticker tactile landmarks, touch type.

title: VHP: Vibrotactile Haptics Platform for On-body Applications
summary: A battery-powered, programmable 12-channel vibrotactile driver board (nRF52840, class-D amplifiers) with per-channel current-based load sensing for LRAs and voice coils, demonstrated in a bracelet, sleeve and phone case.

title: Weirding Haptics: In-Situ Prototyping of Vibrotactile Feedback in Virtual Reality through Vocalization
summary: A Unity VR design tool that turns the designer's vocalizations, recorded while manipulating virtual objects, into vibrotactile feedback on the Oculus Quest 2 controller or a custom actuator, with inferred spatio-temporal mappings, layers and fine-tuning modifiers.

title: X-Rings: A Hand-mounted 360° Shape Display for Grasping in Virtual Reality
summary: A hand-mounted 360-degree shape display made of four stacked motor-driven expandable rings (5.7-7.7 cm) that renders radially symmetric graspable objects in VR and senses touch and grip force via capacitance and motor current.

title: AirLogic: Embedding Pneumatic Computation and I/O in 3D Models to Fabricate Electronics-Free Interactive Objects
summary: A technique that embeds pneumatic input, flueric logic gate and output widgets (13 widgets) in FDM 3D-printed models to fabricate electronics-free interactive objects powered by pressurized air.

title: ARDW: An Augmented Reality Workbench for Printed Circuit Board Debugging
summary: A projected-augmented-reality PCB debugging workbench that cross-links KiCAD schematic and layout views on a monitor with highlights projected onto the physical board, using motion-captured test probes and a connected benchtop multimeter.

title: Computational Design of Active Kinesthetic Garments
summary: Computational pipeline that uses dual-objective on-body topology optimization (BESO) to design connecting structures between electrostatic (ES) clutches on compliant garments, producing active kinesthetic garments that resist chosen body motions on demand.

title: DeltaPen: A Device with Integrated High-Precision Translation and Rotation Sensing on Passive Surfaces
summary: A digital pen with two adjacent lens-less optical flow sensors, an IMU, a pressure sensor and a linear resonant actuator that senses precise translation, yaw rotation and tilt on passive surfaces and renders haptic effects.

title: DigituSync: A Dual-User Passive Exoskeleton Glove That Adaptively Shares Hand Gestures
summary: DigituSync, a dual-user passive exoskeleton glove of 3D-printed four-bar linkages with variable-length linkages and magnetic attachment, lets two users share finger motion and force with adjustable transmission ratio and no electronics.

title: DiscoBand: Multiview Depth-Sensing Smartwatch Strap for Hand, Body and Environment Tracking
summary: A smartwatch strap with sixteen ultra-small multi-zone VL53L5CX time-of-flight depth sensors (eight hand-facing, eight outward-facing) on flexible PCBs that composites a multiview point cloud to track hand, arm and upper-body pose and the environment.

title: ELAXO : Rendering Versatile Resistive Force Feedback for Fingers Grasping and Twisting
summary: A wearable three-finger exoskeleton with detachable rotatable rings, mechanical brakes and elastic bands that renders continuous resistive force and rotational resistive force, with or without resilience, for grasping and twisting in VR.

title: EtherPose: Continuous Hand Pose Tracking with Wrist-Worn Antenna Impedance Characteristic Sensing
summary: A wrist-worn band with two cloverleaf antennas, each read by a NanoVNA V2, that measures swept-frequency S11 impedance changes and uses ExtraTreesRegressor models to track continuous 3D hand pose, wrist angle and micro-gestures.

title: Fibercuit: Prototyping High-Resolution Flexible and Kirigami Circuits with a Fiber Laser Engraver
summary: Fibercuit: rapid prototyping techniques using a desktop 50W fiber laser engraver to cut fine-pitch traces in copper-Kapton composites, laser solder SMD components, and laser form kirigami flexible circuits, with a Three.js design interface.

title: Flaticulation: Laser Cutting Joints with Articulated Angles
summary: Flaticulation is a laser-cutting method using two special T-patterns (<θ and >θ) on a shared edge so two cut-in-place flat boards clutch at designated articulated angles, forming articulated joints and detent hinges, with a Rhino plugin that unfolds 3D polygonal models.

title: Flexel: A Modular Floor Interface for Room-Scale Tactile Sensing
summary: Flexel is a modular floor interface of raised floor modules (TN-50) with four-load-sensor quad-pods cells and custom PCBs that sense load center for room-scale footprint, gesture, touch and object sensing.

title: ForceSight: Non-Contact Force Sensing with Laser Speckle Imaging
summary: A non-contact force sensing approach using laser speckle imaging, where a defocused camera and a 532 nm laser detect speckle shifts from minute surface deformations and a signal-processing pipeline with optical flow and regression estimates applied force.

title: HapTag: A Compact Actuator for Rendering Push-Button Tactility on Soft Surfaces
summary: HapTag is a thin, flexible HASEL-based actuator of TPU and PET metalized film with an integrated FlexiForce pressure sensor that renders push-button tactility on soft surfaces.

title: HingeCore: Laser-Cut Foamcore for Fast Assembly
summary: A laser-cut foamcore structure (HingeCore) whose finger hinges, made by half-way laser cutting, allow fast glue-free assembly by folding, plus software (HingeCoreMaker) converting 3D models into 2D cutting plans.

title: Integrating Living Organisms in Devices to Implement Care-based Interactions
summary: A smartwatch with a custom PCB and a transparent acrylic enclosure in which the user feeds a Physarum polycephalum slime mold that grows into a living wire powering a MAX3010 heart rate sensor, studied for care-based interactions over 9-14 days.

title: Integrating Real-World Distractions into Virtual Reality
summary: A sensing module attached to a VR headset detects real-world distractions (sounds, wind, temperature shifts) and triggers pre-designed VR effects with direct or stretch mapping to keep presence.

title: interiqr: Unobtrusive Edible Tags using Food 3D Printing
summary: interiqr: embeds hidden edible QR/ArUco tags inside food 3D-printed cookies by shaping infill air space or secondary black-colored dough, decoded under backlight illumination with simple image processing.

title: iWood: Makeable Vibration Sensor for Interactive Plywood
summary: Interactive plywood with a triboelectric vibration sensor (PTFE film between staggered nickel-coated diamond-grid electrodes) that survives sawing, screwing and nailing and recognizes gestures and activities on tables, nightstands and cutting boards.

title: Kinergy: Creating 3D Printable Motion using Embedded Kinetic Energy
summary: Kinergy is a Rhino/Grasshopper design tool that embeds parameterizable 3D printable kinetic units (helical or spiral springs, compliant locks, gear transmissions) into 3D models to create self-propelled, print-in-place motion.

title: Look over there! Investigating Saliency Modulation for Visual Guidance with Augmented Reality Glasses
summary: Computational Glasses: Epson Moverio BT-300 optical see-through AR glasses modified with 50/50 beamsplitters and eye-aligned scene cameras that display an additive-only saliency modulation overlay to guide users' gaze in the real world.

title: MagneShape: A Non-electrical Pin-Based Shape-Changing Display
summary: A non-electrical pin-based shape-changing display (MagneShape) in which magnetic pins with pot magnets in a housing levitate above a patterned magnetic rubber sheet, with design tools and low-cost pin fabrication methods.

title: MechARspace: An Authoring System Enabling Bidirectional Binding of Augmented Reality with Toys in Real-time
summary: An immersive HoloLens 2 authoring system with a plug-and-play IoT module toolkit that lets users bind AR content and physical toys bidirectionally through programming by demonstration and trigger-action visual programming.

title: MetamorphX: An Ungrounded 3-DoF Moment Display that Changes its Physical Properties through Rotational Impedance Control
summary: MetamorphX is an ungrounded, handheld 3-DoF moment display of four control moment gyroscopes plus an IMU that uses rotational impedance control to change the inertia and viscosity felt when swinging a wielded object in VR.

title: Mixels: Fabricating Interfaces using Programmable Magnetic Pixels
summary: Programmable magnetic pixels written and read on soft magnetic sheet by an electromagnet and hall effect sensor printhead clipped onto a SnapMaker 3-axis CNC, with a design interface for selectively attractive, repulsive and agnostic patterns.

title: Muscle Synergies Learning with Electrical Muscle Stimulation for Playing the Piano
summary: An electrical muscle stimulation (EMS) system that stimulates the deltoid muscle when the E key is pressed on an electric piano, teaching beginners the thumb-under method and new muscle synergies for playing even scales.

title: NFCStack: Identifiable Physical Building Blocks that Support Concurrent Construction and Frictionless Interaction
summary: NFCStack, a passive physical building block system of bricks, boxes and adapters on stations with a multiplexed NFC reader (RC522 with CD74HC4067 multiplexer) that uses transmission line and multihop relay-coil antenna extension to resolve stacking order and frictionless interaction concurrently.

title: PassengXR: A Low Cost Platform for Any-Car, Multi-User, Motion-Based Passenger XR Experiences
summary: An open-source Unity toolkit with a reference set of off-the-shelf SparkFun ESP32 vehicle sensor boards that broadcast car telemetry to multiple standalone Pico Neo 3 Pro headsets for passenger XR experiences in any car.

title: Photographic Lighting Design with Photographer-in-the-Loop Bayesian Optimization
summary: A photographer-in-the-loop preferential Bayesian optimization framework that finds good lighting configurations by having the photographer pick the best of four suggested images and paint rough guidance, demonstrated in Blender simulation and with robotic-arm-held lights.

title: Project Primrose: Reflective Light-Diffuser Modules for Non-Emissive Flexible Display Systems
summary: Reflective light-diffuser modules built from reflective-backed polymer-dispersed liquid crystal (PDLC) petals on flexible PCBs, shown in a Primrose Canvas and Primrose Bag, with content authoring and interaction tools.

title: Prolonging VR Haptic Experiences by Harvesting Kinetic Energy from the User
summary: A batteryless elbow exoskeleton harvests the user's kinetic energy with a geared DC motor generator and electropermanent magnet clutch into supercapacitors, while VR renders resistive scenes to power vibration, EMS and braking haptics.

title: Prototyping Soft Devices with Interactive Bioplastics
summary: Interactive Bioplastics are DIY conductive bioplastic sheets, pastes and foams (carbon black or activated charcoal in gelatin, alginate, starch glue or CMC glue) patterned by plotter cutting or stencil painting to make soft, re-meltable, biodegradable circuits and sensors.

title: Reconfigurable Elastic Metamaterials
summary: A reconfigurable elastic metamaterial sheet of 3D-printed Ninjaflex spring and damper cells in a checkerboard, locally tuned by user-printed PLA coupling lids with hooks and a Rhino-based configuration editor.

title: Seeing our Blind Spots: Smart Glasses-based Simulation to Increase Design Students’ Awareness of Visual Impairment
summary: Visual Impairment Simulation Glasses: optical see-through glasses built by fitting two transparent monochrome LCD panels onto a Pupil Core eye tracker to render gaze-dependent central or peripheral vision loss for design students.

title: SenSequins: Smart Textile Using 3D Printed Conductive Sequins
summary: A smart textile of 3D-printed conductive PLA sequins sewn onto fabric with conductive thread, sensing motion, touch and bending by sequins contacting or flipping, with Rhinoceros/Grasshopper design software and computerized embroidery for automatic sewing.

title: ShrinkCells: Localized and Sequential Shape-Changing Actuation of 3D-Printed Objects via Selective Heating
summary: Dual-material 3D-printed shape-changing actuators in which conductive PLA zigzag traces selectively Joule-heat Shape Memory Polymer layers to shrink or bend locally, with 3D printed fuses for sequential actuation from a single power supply.

title: spaceR: Knitting Ready-Made, Tactile, and Highly Responsive Spacer-Fabric Force Sensors for Continuous Input
summary: spaceR, a resistive force sensor knitted ready-made as a spacer fabric with nylon monofilament filler plated with Resistat resistive yarn and silver-plated conductive traces on a two-bed weft knitting machine, used as continuous-input buttons, rocker and 4-way controllers.

title: TangibleGrid: Tangible Web Layout Design for Blind Users
summary: Tangible device for blind users to understand and design web page layouts: a magnetic pogo-pin baseboard senses resizable scissored-linkage brackets and speaks and renders their type, size and location.

title: TipTrap: A Co-located Direct Manipulation Technique for Acoustically Levitated Content.
summary: TipTrap is a co-located direct manipulation technique that uses ultrasound reflections off the fingertip to create Opportunistic Traps 2.1 mm below tracked fingertips, letting users select, move and release acoustically levitated particles.

title: WaddleWalls: Room-scale Interactive Partitioning System using a Swarm of Robotic Partitions
summary: A swarm of four vertically stretchable robotic partitions (roll-up screen on a standing-desk lift atop a Roomba Create 2) that autonomously arrange room-scale layouts specified with a VIVE controller and tracked by VIVE trackers.

title: X-Bridges: Designing Tunable Bridges to Enrich 3D Printed Objects' Deformation and Stiffness
summary: End-to-end workflow for designing tunable FDM bridges (bend, twist, coil, compress, stretch primitives in loose, elastic, stable stiffness) with a Grasshopper design tool that previews deformation and generates optimized G-code.

title: 3D Printing Magnetophoretic Displays
summary: A pipeline for 3D printing magnetophoretic displays: a Creality Ender 3 Pro modified with a syringe injector injects an oil and iron powder mixture into printed voxel cells, with a Rhino 3D editor and custom G-code.

title: AirTied: Automatic Personal Fabrication of Truss Structures
summary: Device that fabricates inflatable truss structures automatically by unrolling a 20cm-wide TPU-coated nylon tube, bookmarking segments in slots and tying nodes with a wire tie gun, with an editor and exporter producing G-Code.

title: An Adaptable Workflow for Manual-Computational Ceramic Surface Ornamentation
summary: An interactive Rhino/Grasshopper workflow for procedurally generating patterns on a 3D model of a radially symmetrical ceramic vessel and unrolling them into 2D stencils cut on a vinyl cutter or laser cutter for manual ornamentation.

title: Biohybrid Devices: Prototyping Interactive Devices with Growable Materials
summary: Biohybrid Devices: a fabrication framework and seven techniques (Grow Around, Layering, Imbuing, Pocket slicing, Carbonization, Painting, Laser Engraving & Filling) for embedding electronics in bacterial cellulose grown from a SCOBY across its Growth, Stabilization and Inanimate phases.

title: BioWeave: Weaving Thread-Based Sweat-Sensing On-Skin Interfaces
summary: Woven thread-based sweat-sensing on-skin interfaces made by dyeing cotton threads with colorimetric assays from test strips or coating them with electrochemical pH and glucose sensing layers, then weaving them on an 8-shaft floor loom into 2D and 3D structures.

title: BrightMarker: 3D Printed Fluorescent Markers for Object Tracking
summary: BrightMarker embeds invisible ArUco and QR markers in multi-material 3D printed objects using a NIR-fluorescent ABS filament, tracked in real time by a filtered NIR camera and LED module for phones and AR/VR headsets.

title: BrushLens: Hardware Interaction Proxies for Accessible Touchscreen Interface Actuation
summary: A hardware phone case with an array of solenoid or capacitive touchscreen autoclicker actuators that, using the iPhone camera, IMU and a darkfield sensor to localize itself, actuates inaccessible touchscreens on behalf of visually or motor impaired users.

title: Computational Design of Personalized Wearable Robotic Limbs
summary: An interactive body-aware computational design tool that captures a user's body dimensions and task poses with markerless MoCap and optimizes fabricable (3D-printed, laser-cut) personalized Wearable Robotic Limbs with servomotors.

title: Constraint-Driven Robotic Surfaces, At Human-Scale
summary: An architectural-scale robotic surface of four columns of seventeen double-hinged FR4-PET cells whose hinges are constrained by servo-rotated clamps, with belt-driven gearmotors at the column ends squeezing columns into shapes like shelves and desks.

title: CubeSense++: Smart Environment Sensing with Interaction-Powered Corner Reflector Mechanisms
summary: CubeSense++ uses 3D-printed, battery-free corner reflector mechanisms with gear and magnetic-coupling transmissions that encode interactions with everyday objects into millimeter wave radar responses, decoded to state, direction, rate, count and usage.

title: Double-Sided Tactile Interactions for Grasping in Virtual Reality
summary: A thin, flexible double-sided electrotactile device with two overlapping 3x3 inkjet-printed silver electrode arrays stimulating thumb and index fingerpads, enabling single-sided, simultaneous and spatiotemporal double-sided tactile interactions for pinching in VR.

title: Dynamic Toolchains: Software Infrastructure for Digital Fabrication Workflows
summary: Dynamic Toolchains: a browser-based, event-driven dataflow environment with a module library and module development framework (Python backend, JavaScript web components) for building and running digital fabrication workflows and live machine control.

title: EmTex: Prototyping Textile-Based Interfaces through An Embroidered Construction Kit
summary: A construction kit of 28 machine-embroidered textile sensors, actuators, displays and hook-and-loop connectors, with a node-based visual programming tool, for stick-and-play prototyping of smart textile interfaces.

title: FeetThrough: Electrotactile Foot Interface that Preserves Real-World Sensations
summary: A 60-electrode flexible-PCB electrotactile foot interface (thin polyimide array, photorelay multiplexer driven by a RehaStim stimulator) that stimulates the sole while letting users feel the real terrain, shown in VR, yoga and AR navigation.

title: FibeRobo: Fabricating 4D Fiber Interfaces by Continuous Drawing of Temperature Tunable Liquid Crystal Elastomers
summary: FibeRobo: thermally actuated liquid crystal elastomer (LCE) fiber, continuously drawn and UV-cured with a custom fiber drawing machine, with tunable actuation temperature, usable in embroidery, weaving and knitting for 4D textiles.

title: Fluid Reality: High-Resolution, Untethered Haptic Gloves using Electroosmotic Pump Arrays
summary: Untethered five-finger haptic glove with 160 haptic pixels (20 pixels/cm2) built from fingerpad arrays of embedded electroosmotic pumps (EEOPs) driven by high-voltage shift registers, for high-resolution tactile feedback in AR/VR.

title: HoloBots: Augmenting Holographic Telepresence with Mobile Robots for Tangible Remote Collaboration in Mixed Reality
summary: A mixed reality remote collaboration system that synchronizes a remote user's holographic avatar (Hololens 2 and Azure Kinect) with tabletop Sony Toio mobile robots so remote users can physically actuate objects, share tangible UIs and give haptic feedback.

title: KnitScript: A Domain-Specific Scripting Language for Advanced Machine Knitting
summary: KnitScript is a domain-specific scripting language and interpreter, extensible with Python, that compiles to Knitout instructions for knitting machines using a virtual machine model, sheet and layer abstractions, and automatic transfer planning.

title: MagKnitic: Machine-knitted Passive and Interactive Haptic Textiles with Integrated Binary Sensing
summary: Machine-knitted textiles that combine ferromagnetic yarn (Filix) patches and pocketed permanent magnets for passive force feedback, with binary sensing from resistance drop via conductive yarn, made with parametric Knitout templates on a digital knitting machine.

title: Neighbor-Environment Observer: An Intelligent Agent for Immersive Working Companionship
summary: A neighbor-environment observer agent that jointly observes physical (RGB cameras, microphone) and VR/PC environments via an And-Or Graph decision module and acts through desktop robots carrying trays and virtual counterparts to handle disruptions for HTC Vive users.

title: Pantœnna: Mouth pose estimation for ar/vr headsets using low-profile antenna and impedance characteristic sensing
summary: A low-profile dual cross-polarized slot antenna on the underside of a Meta Quest 2 headset, read with a NanoVNA as S11/S21 impedance characteristics, estimates 11 3D mouth keypoints without cameras or audio.

title: Parametric Haptics: Versatile Geometry-based Tactile Feedback Devices
summary: Parametric Haptics are soft 3D-printed TPU tactile patches with tendon-inspired actuation geometry that move many tactors over the skin from one pull by micro gear motors on a generic wearable actuation interface.

title: PressurePick: Muscle Tension Estimation for Guitar Players Using Unobtrusive Pressure Sensing
summary: PressurePick is a wearable guitar pick with a single force sensing resistor and a glove-mounted ESP32C3 that records pick pressure to estimate perceived muscle tension, shown in a tab-based front end.

title: RadarFoot: Fine-grain Ground Surface Context Awareness for Smart Shoes
summary: A shoe prototype embedding an Acconeer XR112 60GHz mmWave radar sensor that classifies ground surface types, wet/dry condition and gait motion types while walking, using Random Forest on features from reflected-signal envelopes.

title: Reprogrammable Digital Metamaterials for Interactive Devices
summary: Reprogrammable digital mechanical metamaterials built from 3D-printed bistable-spring bit cells with an integrated recharge lever and replaceable logic filters, enabling multi-round computation, haptic floor, message display and tactile desktop reminder.

title: ShadowTouch: Enabling Free-Form Touch-Based Hand-to-Surface Interaction with Wrist-Mounted Illuminant by Shadow Projection
summary: A wrist-mounted forward-facing LED casts finger shadows on a surface, which a head-mounted 120 FPS camera and a two-stage MediaPipe plus MobileNet V3 CNN use to recognize per-finger touch states for hand-to-surface interaction in VR.

title: Skinergy: Machine-Embroidered Silicone-Textile Composites as On-Skin Self-Powered Input Sensors
summary: Skinergy is a self-powered on-skin input sensor: machine-embroidered conductive thread in cast silicone-textile composites forms triboelectric nanogenerators, read by a wireless sensing board for touch, localization and gesture recognition.

title: SleeveIO: Modular and Reconfigurable Platform for Multimodal Wearable Haptic Feedback Interactions
summary: SleeveIO is a modular, reconfigurable wearable haptics platform of machine-knitted sleeve and band substrates with magnetic cap-and-pole couplings that attach vibrotactor, bellow, muscle, suction/puff cup and quad-chamber modules, driven by FlowIO.

title: SPEERLoom: An Open-Source Loom Kit for Interdisciplinary Engagement in Math, Engineering, and Textiles
summary: SPEERLoom is an open-source robotic Jacquard loom kit with 40 individually linear-actuated warp yarns, a passive spring-and-disk tensioning system and creel, and a Python GUI for weave factor and cloth integrity, tested in a college class.

title: Stereoscopic Viewing and Monoscopic Touching: Selecting Distant Objects in VR Through a Mobile Device
summary: A VR distant-selection technique that treats a smartphone-sized transparent acrylic panel as a window, switching from stereoscopic viewing to monoscopic touching with an animated flattening transition as the fingertip approaches, tracked via Meta Quest 2 hand tracking.

title: Structured Light Speckle: Joint Ego-Centric Depth Estimation and Low-Latency Contact Detection via Remote Vibrometry
summary: Structured Light Speckle fuses a diffracted 532 nm laser grid and an RGB camera for sparse depth and plane detection with an exposed-sensor monochrome camera reading laser speckle for remote vibrometry, implemented as the TapLight Quest 2 add-on that detects surfaces and touches.

title: Style2Fab: Functionality-Aware Segmentation for Fabricating Personalized 3D Models with Generative AI
summary: A Blender plugin that segments 3D-printable meshes into functional and aesthetic segments using spectral segmentation and topological similarity, then applies Text2Mesh text-prompt stylization only to aesthetic segments.

title: Substiports: User-Inserted Ad Hoc Objects as Reusable Structural Support for Unmodified FDM 3D Printers
summary: A software-only modified Kiri:Moto slicer that replaces printed support with user-inserted ad hoc objects (books, toy bricks, screw jacks) held by printed holders, cutting print time and material on unmodified FDM 3D printers.

title: Sustainflatable: Harvesting, Storing and Utilizing Ambient Energy for Pneumatic Morphing Interfaces
summary: Sustainflatable is an electronic-free pneumatic system with ambient-energy-harvesting pumps (thermal, moisture, kinetic), variable volume-pressure storage units and environment-triggered valves, plus a Grasshopper design tool and garden applications.

title: TacNote: Tactile and Audio Note-Taking for Non-Visual Access
summary: A mobile web app plus a modified low-temperature 3Doodler Start+ 3D printing pen lets blind and visually impaired users draw tactile graphics, scan them with a camera, annotate them, and explore them by finger-pointing with audio feedback.

title: TactTongue: Prototyping ElectroTactile Stimulations on the Tongue
summary: An oral prototyping toolkit that renders electrotactile stimulation (and a few tastes) on the tongue with an 18-electrode flexible PCB array driven by Arduino Uno/Nano shields, also sensing touch input, plus a WPF design tool.

title: Taste Retargeting via Chemical Taste Modulators
summary: Taste retargeting delivers droplets of chemical taste modulators (lactisole, miraculin, zinc sulfate and others) to the mouth through a wearable peristaltic-pump device so one food prop tastes like many virtual foods in VR.

title: Telextiles: End-to-end Remote Transmission of Fabric Tactile Sensation
summary: A hand-held DIGIT optical tactile sensor in a spring-loaded 3D printed jig feeds a MoCo contrastive self-supervised encoder, and a stepper-driven roller of 16 textile samples presents the closest textile to a remote user.

title: ThermalRouter: Enabling Users to Design Thermally-Sound Devices
summary: ThermalRouter is an Autodesk Fusion 360 CAD plugin that automatically routes heat channels of thermally-conductive ICE9 nylon filament or EGaIn metallic-silicone through a model, picking the best design via automated thermal FEA simulation.

title: Turn-It-Up: Rendering Resistance for Knobs in Virtual Reality through Undetectable Pseudo-Haptics
summary: Pseudo-Haptic Resistance slows the virtual rotation of a motorized proxy knob (C/D gain below 1.0) in VR to convey physical resistance, with detection thresholds, a perceived-torque model and use cases.

title: VoxelHap: A Toolkit for Constructing Proxies Providing Tactile and Kinesthetic Haptic Feedback in Virtual Reality
summary: A block-based toolkit of Voxels (BaseVoxel, VibrationVoxel, RotationVoxel) and 3D-printed Plates for constructing handheld VR proxy objects with tactile and kinesthetic haptic feedback, extended with VR illusions.

title: VRoxy: Wide-Area Collaboration From an Office Using a VR-Driven Robotic Proxy
summary: A VR-driven robotic proxy that maps a Quest Pro user's walking in a small room to a mobile robot with an articulated display and 2DoF pointing arm in a larger remote space, blending a pre-scanned 3D mesh navigation view with live 360 camera video.

title: Augmented Breathing via Thermal Feedback in the Nose
summary: A wireless wearable nose clip with Peltier elements and an air pressure sensor that cools or heats the nasal septum in sync with inhalation to alter perceived nasal airflow (breathing easier or harder).

title: avaTTAR: Table Tennis Stroke Training with Embodied and Detached Visualization in Augmented Reality
summary: An augmented reality table tennis stroke training system on a HoloLens 2 that tracks body (webcam 3D pose estimation) and paddle (IMU) and shows expert and user avatars as detached and on-body visual cues.

title: Can a Smartwatch Move Your Fingers? Compact and Practical Electrical Muscle Stimulation in a Smartwatch
summary: A wrist-EMS device integrated into a Galaxy Watch 5 band uses cross-sectional electrical muscle stimulation from 12 wrist electrodes to actuate thumb, index, middle, pinky fingers and wrist without forearm electrodes.

title: CARDinality: Interactive Card-shaped Robots with Locomotion and Haptics using Vibration
summary: Card-shaped robots on a semi-flexible PCB with four ERM vibration motors that slide omni-directionally on tables and give in-hand haptics, with an IMU, BLE, and locomotion models trained via a camera-based 'robot school'.

title: Degrade to Function: Towards Eco-friendly Morphing Devices that Function Through Programmed Sequential Degradation
summary: Degrade to Function is a design strategy for autonomous, power-free morphing devices from natural degradable materials (Mg foil, agar mixture, alginate, soluble paper, waxes, PHA, wood, rubber) whose environment-triggered degradation of constraints releases stored elastic energy in sequence.

title: DexteriSync: A Hand Thermal I/O Exoskeleton for Morphing Finger Dexterity Experience
summary: DexteriSync is a hand thermal I/O exoskeleton using copper-silicone finger tube segments and circulating Peltier-cooled or heated water to change finger skin temperature, modulating dexterity and thermal perception.

title: Don't Mesh Around: Streamlining Manual-Digital Fabrication Workflows with Domain-Specific 3D Scanning
summary: The Craft-Aligned Scanner (CAS) adds a Keyence IL-300 laser displacement sensor on a vertical linear actuator to the Digital Pottery Wheel (polar-coordinate clay 3D printer), recording a thrown vessel as a replayable spiral step-and-direction toolpath, with a real-time knob-controlled texturizer.

title: E-Joint: Fabrication of Large-Scale Interactive Objects Assembled by 3D Printed Conductive Parts with Copper Plated Joints
summary: E-Joint is a fabrication pipeline and Rhino3D/Grasshopper plug-in that generates electrified mortise-and-tenon joints from bi-material printed conductive PLA, copper-electroplated, so large 3D printed interactive objects connect physically and electrically.

title: EarHover: Mid-Air Gesture Recognition for Hearables Using Sound Leakage Signals
summary: Mid-air gesture recognition for in-ear and open-ear hearables that plays a 20 kHz sound leakage signal, records its Doppler shift with an external microphone, and classifies spectrogram images with CNNs.

title: Embrogami: Shape-Changing Textiles with Machine Embroidery
summary: Embrogami embroiders bistable origamic mountain/valley structures on pre-stretched fabric with a digital embroidery machine, with elastic tuning, fabric capacitive sensing, SMA actuation, a design tool and four textile applications.

title: Fiery Hands: Designing Thermal Glove through Thermal and Tactile Integration for Virtual Object Manipulation
summary: Fiery Hands are thermo-tactile gloves that combine flexible Peltier thermal actuators on finger backs and palm edge with coin vibrotactile actuators to create vibrotactile-induced thermal referral illusions for localized and global heat in VR.

title: Flip-Pelt: Motor-Driven Peltier Elements for Rapid Thermal Stimulation and Congruent Pressure Feedback in Virtual Reality
summary: Flip-Pelt, a forearm-worn device in which servo motors flip dual-sided, pre-heated or pre-cooled Peltier elements into skin contact within about 450 ms, giving rapid thermal feedback with stiffness-dependent pressure for VR.

title: HandPad: Make Your Hand an On-the-go Writing Pad via Human Capacitance
summary: HandPad is a wearable system that uses a single three-channel capacitive sensor on three fingertips to measure human capacitance, turning the back of the hand into a keystroke and handwriting input pad.

title: HoloChemie - Sustainable Fabrication of Soft Biochemical Holographic Devices for Ubiquitous Sensing
summary: Sustainable, vegan-friendly analyte-sensitive holographic biochemical sensors (lactate oxidase, glucose oxidase, bromothymol blue, hibiscus anthocyanin assays on alginate, agarose, paper and fabric substrates) read by a portable LED-LDR array and Random Forest model.

title: Hydroptical Thermal Feedback: Spatial Thermal Feedback Using Visible Lights and Water
summary: Hydroptical thermal feedback: 100 W LEDs surrounding a water tank shine visible light through water onto submerged skin to give adjustable, spatial warmth and coolness and an illusion of warmer water.

title: IRIS: Wireless ring for vision-based smart home interaction
summary: IRIS, a wireless camera-and-IMU smart ring that streams images over Bluetooth to an iPhone, where YOLOv8, CODA and DINOv2 identify the pointed-at smart home device instance for control by press and rotation gestures.

title: JetUnit: Rendering Diverse Force Feedback in Virtual Reality Using Water Jets
summary: JetUnit is a wearable VR force-feedback device that fires water jets from a nozzle onto an elastic membrane in a chamber with recycling pump, ring channel, protective sleeve and air-pressure balancing, rendering 16 to 442 kPa and up to 10 Hz.

title: KODA: Knit-program Optimization by Dependency Analysis
summary: KODA is an optimizer for Knitout knitting machine programs that builds an expanded knitgraph and a dependency graph, removes redundant transfers and clusters operations into carriage passes, so programs knit reliably on a v-bed knitting machine.

title: LoopBot: Representing Continuous Haptics of Grounded Objects in Room-scale VR
summary: A looped rubber-tube haptic prop on a Mecanum wheeled robot that follows the user and scrolls to cancel the robot's motion, giving continuous grounded handrail haptics in room-scale VR.

title: MagneDot: Integrated Fabrication and Actuation Methods of Dot-Based Magnetic Shape Displays
summary: MagneDot is a custom CoreXY FDM 3D printer with pneumatic extrusion, magnetizer and actuation add-ons plus a Rhinoceros/Grasshopper design tool that molds, casts, magnetizes and actuates NdFeB-silicone dot-based magnetic soft shape displays via G-code.

title: MobiPrint: A Mobile 3D Printer for Environment-Scale Design and Fabrication
summary: MobiPrint is a mobile 3D printer, a Prusa Mini+ FDM printer on a modified Roborock S5 vacuum robot, that maps indoor spaces with LiDAR and prints objects on the floor, with a web design tool.

title: MouthIO: Fabricating Customizable Oral User Interfaces with Integrated Sensing and Actuation
summary: A design and fabrication method for customizable oral interfaces: resin-printed open-bite or closed braces with a water-proof PCB housing holding a flexible PCB, battery, microcontroller and sensors or actuators, designed with a Blender plugin.

title: Mul-O: Encouraging Olfactory Innovation in Various Scenarios Through a Task-Oriented Development Platform
summary: An Event-Condition-Action based olfactory development toolkit with a Web-UI, Django API server, cloud Coordinator and networked ESP32 piezo air pump and piezo atomizer odor display devices for task-oriented smell-augmented applications.

title: OptiBasePen: Mobile Base+Pen Input on Passive Surfaces by Sensing Relative Base Motion Plus Close-Range Pen Position
summary: A pen with an infrared LED plus a movable base for the resting hand that combines a PMW3389 mouse sensor (relative motion) with two PAJ7025R3 object tracking sensors (absolute pen tip position) for pen input on ordinary surfaces.

title: Palmrest+: Expanding Laptop Input Space with Shear Force on Palm-Resting Area
summary: Palmrest+ adds shear-force input to laptop palmrests using Trackpoint pointing-stick modules with FSRs, enabling Palmrest Shortcut (directional Push commands) and Palmrest Joystick (rate-controlled values) without leaving the home typing position.

title: picoRing: battery-free rings for subtle thumb-to-index input
summary: A battery-free ring with a fully-passive sensor coil and passive mechanical switches is read out by a compact wristband reader coil using passive inductive telemetry with distributed capacitance arrangement, a bridge circuit and peak detection for thumb-to-index press, slide and scroll input.

title: PointerVol: A Laser Pointer for Swept Volumetric Displays
summary: A modified laser pointer that pulses its laser in sync with a swept volumetric display's diffuser, setting dot depth with an analog joystick or an ultrasonic distance sensor, for pointing in true-3D graphics.

title: PortaChrome: A Portable Contact Light Source for Integrated Re-Programmable Multi-Color Textures
summary: A flexible, portable contact light source made of UV and addressable RGB LEDs on a textile substrate with a silicone diffusion layer, which reprograms multi-color textures on objects coated with photochromic dye.

title: Power-over-Skin: Full-Body Wearables Powered By Intra-Body RF Energy
summary: Power-over-Skin: a worn battery-powered 40 MHz square-wave transmitter couples RF energy through the body to tiny battery-free receiver boards that power wearables such as a ring joystick, earrings, a temperature patch and an e-ink sun monitor.

title: RFTIRTouch: Touch Sensing Device for Dual-sided Transparent Plane Based on Repropagated Frustrated Total Internal Reflection
summary: A slim camera-based sensing device that sticks onto glass or acrylic with paraffin oil and an acrylic prism and estimates touch position on both sides of the plate from repropagated frustrated total internal reflection (RFTIR) images using physics-based ray geometry.

title: SeamPose: Repurposing Seams as Capacitive Sensors in a Shirt for Upper-Body Pose Tracking
summary: A long-sleeve shirt whose existing seams are machine-sewn with insulated conductive thread to act as 8 capacitive sensing seam electrodes, read by a custom board and a Bi-LSTM deep-learning pipeline that estimates 3D upper-body joint positions.

title: Selfrionette: A Fingertip Force-Input Controller for Continuous Full-Body Avatar Manipulation and Diverse Haptic Interactions
summary: A handheld spherical casing with five single-beam load cells that converts force input from the thumb, index and middle fingers into whole-body avatar movement (hands, feet, grasping, walking in place) in VR, with force-based haptic rendering of weight, friction and compliance.

title: SHAPE-IT: Exploring Text-to-Shape-Display for Generative Shape-Changing Behaviors with LLMs
summary: SHAPE-IT is a text-to-shape-display authoring system that uses chained GPT models to turn natural-language commands into JavaScript (Primitive, Animation, Interaction) controlling a replicated 24 x 24 inFORM pin-based shape display.

title: SonoHaptics: An Audio-Haptic Cursor for Gaze-Based Object Selection in XR
summary: An audio-haptic cursor for gaze-based object selection in XR that maps object color lightness, size, material and position to audio pitch, haptic amplitude, timbre and spatial audio direction, delivered via a four-actuator wristband and headset speakers.

title: Speed-Modulated Ironing: High-Resolution Shade and Texture Gradients in Single-Material 3D Printing
summary: Speed-Modulated Ironing: on an unmodified dual-nozzle FDM printer one nozzle prints temperature-responsive filament and the second, empty heated nozzle irons each layer at varying speeds to program color shade, translucency and texture, with a Grasshopper gcode post-processing tool.

title: SpinShot: Optimizing Both Physical and Perceived Force Feedback of Flywheel-Based, Directional Impact Handheld Devices
summary: A handheld flywheel-based directional impact feedback device (SpinShot) with a solenoid-actuated stopper that halts the flywheel in 1 ms for 22 Nm torque, plus a hard+soft reversal design, for VR baseball.

title: StructCurves: Interlocking Block-Based Line Structures
summary: A pipeline that generates zipper-like chains of 3D-printed interlocking blocks with revolute joints on an embedded fiberglass mesh backbone, printed flat on an Ultimaker S5 and assembled by pivoting into rigid load-bearing curved structures.

title: TorqueCapsules: Fully-Encapsulated Flywheel Actuation Modules for Designing and Prototyping Movement-Based and Kinesthetic Interaction
summary: TorqueCapsule is a palm-sized fully encapsulated flywheel actuation module (brushless DC motor, steel flywheel, wireless microcontroller, LiPo battery, replaceable lids) with a timeline GUI for prototyping movement and kinesthetic haptics.

title: TouchpadAnyWear: Textile-Integrated Tactile Sensors for Multimodal High Spatial-Resolution Touch Inputs with Motion Artifacts Tolerance
summary: Textile-integrated capacitive sensor arrays (8x8 pixels, 25/cm2) with knitted textile dielectric core, silicone poly-islands for strain-locking and laser-engraved kirigami openings, fabricated by direct-ink-writing, for touch, gesture and force input on a body-worn touchpad and finger sleeve.

title: Touchscreen-based Hand Tracking for Remote Whiteboard Interaction
summary: A real-time method that reconstructs 3D poses of two hands from capacitive touchscreen images using a recurrent U-Net joint estimator and a constrained inverse kinematics solver on the MANO hand model, with a multi-view capacitive video dataset.

title: TRAvel Slicer: Continuous Extrusion Toolpaths for 3D Printing
summary: TRAvel Slicer is an open-source Python slicer for Grasshopper and Rhino3D that generates continuous-extrusion toolpaths, using connected Fermat spirals and nozzle-height-aware layer ordering, for Direct Write printers such as the Eazao Zero.

title: WatchLink: Enhancing Smartwatches with Sensor Add-Ons via ECG Interface
summary: Add-on sensor modules (UV light, body temperature, buttons, breath alcohol) in watch straps, cases or companion bands send data to commodity smartwatches via frequency modulation read through the watch's ECG interface.

title: What is Affective Touch Made Of? A Soft Capacitive Sensor Array Reveals the Interplay between Shear, Normal Stress and Individuality
summary: A soft capacitive 6x6 array of 5-channel taxels (Ecoflex GEL pillars, conductive-fabric Tx electrodes, flexible PCB, BLE microcontroller) senses 3-axis shear and normal stress, and a 3DCNN classifies 9 affective touch gestures.

title: What's in a cable? Abstracting Knitting Design Elements with Blended Raster/Vector Primitives
summary: Blended primitives are vector stitch/yarn paths and boundaries with raster stitch and yarn blocks, implemented in an open-source browser knitting chart editor with yarn-level simulation that exports instructions for Kniterate machine knitting.

title: Wheeler: A Three-Wheeled Input Device for Usable, Efficient, and Versatile Non-Visual Interaction
summary: Wheeler, a mouse-shaped, stationary, 3D-printed three-wheel input device with two buttons and audio-haptic feedback, letting blind users navigate UI hierarchies (H-nav) and move the cursor in 2D (2d-nav) via NVDA integration.

title: X-Hair: 3D Printing Hair-like Structures with Multi-form, Multi-property and Multi-function
summary: A design and fabrication workflow for 3D printing hair-like structures (bristle, barb, fluff, fine hair, curly hair) on FDM printers via Two-Step Suspend Printing, with a Rhinoceros/Grasshopper design tool that generates G-code.

title: AttraCar: Multisensory In-Car VR with Thermal, Airflow, and Motion Feedback through Built-In Vehicle Systems
summary: AttraCar is a multisensory in-car VR platform that drives a KIA Soul EV's built-in HVAC system and power seat from Unity to give airflow, thermal and seat-motion feedback synchronized with Meta Quest 3 VR content.

title: BandEI: A Flexible Electrical Impedance Sensing Bandage for Deep Muscles and Tendons
summary: BandEI is a bandage-like flexible electrical impedance sensing patch, laser cut from silicone sheets and woven conductive fabric with an EI-Editor design tool, for monitoring deep muscles and tendons at the hand, neck and ankle.

title: BIOGEM: A Fully Biodegradable Gelatin-Based McKibben Actuator with Embedded Sensing
summary: BIOGEM is a fully biodegradable McKibben-style pneumatic actuator with embedded resistive strain sensing, made entirely from gelatin-based composites (gelatin, sugar, glycerol, NaCl) and demonstrated as soil bot, artificial muscle, wave simulator and edible cake.

title: BioLIG: Functionalizing Biocomposites with Laser-induced Graphene for Bio-Rapid Prototyping of Electronics
summary: BioLIG is a fabrication framework that turns self-made bio-based sheets (BioLIG Paper, Fabric, Plastic), paints (BioLIG Ink, Stain) and coatings into biodegradable sensors and circuits via CO2 laser-induced graphene.

title: Buoyancé: Reeling Helium-Inflated Balloons with Mobile Robots on the Ground for Mid-Air Tangible Display, Interaction, and Assembly
summary: Buoyancé combines helium-inflated balloons (HIBs) tethered by string to omnidirectional ReelBot rovers with reeling mechanisms, tracked by OptiTrack, to build room-scale 3D tangible displays, grasp-and-release interaction and mid-air assembly.

title: DissolvPCB: Fully Recyclable 3D-Printed Electronics Using Liquid Metal Conductors and PVA Substrates
summary: DissolvPCB is a fully recyclable printed circuit board assembly whose water-dissolvable PVA substrate is FDM 3D printed with hollow channels filled with EGaIn liquid metal traces, with a FreeCAD plugin converting KiCad designs into printable models.

title: EarPressure VR: Ear Canal Pressure Feedback for Enhancing Environmental Presence in Virtual Reality
summary: EarPressure VR mounts stepper motor-actuated syringes and sealed custom silicone earbuds on a VR HMD to modulate ear canal pressure between -40 and +40 hPa, simulating ambient pressure changes such as underwater descent.

title: EclipseTouch: Touch Segmentation on Ad Hoc Surfaces using Worn Infrared Shadow Casting
summary: A headset-integrated touch and hover sensing technique that uses a Meta Quest 3 instrumented with an infrared camera and synchronized 850 nm LED illuminators to capture structured finger shadows and estimate touch contact and hover distance on ad hoc surfaces with a neural network.

title: Ecolor: Synthesis of EInk Microcapsules for Fabricating DIY Displays
summary: Ecolor is a simplified complex-coacervation recipe for synthesizing EInk microcapsules (single charged TiO2 white particle in dye-colored liquid, gelatin-gum arabic shell) that HCI researchers can make in a wet lab for DIY displays.

title: Efficient Finger Model and Accurate Tracking for Hover-and-Touch, Mid-air and Microgesture Interaction
summary: A marker-based optical finger tracking approach that fits a model of two or three cylinders and a contact sphere per finger from four 3 mm reflective markers, giving millimeter-accurate touch detection for hover-and-touch, mid-air and microgesture interaction.

title: EI-Lite: Electrical Impedance Sensing for Micro-gesture Recognition and Pinch Force Estimation
summary: EI-Lite is a wrist-worn electrical impedance sensing band with four electrodes and a custom complex-valued impedance board that recognizes micro-gestures and estimates continuous pinch force using machine learning and few-shot learning.

title: EmbroChet: A Hybrid Textile Fabrication Approach for 3D Personalized Handicraft via Heat-Shrinking
summary: EmbroChet is a personal fabrication method that threads chain stitches (crochet hook and yarn) through laser-cut holes in heat-shrinkable POF film, which a heat gun shrinks into 3D textiles, with a Grasshopper/Rhinoceros design tool using the Kangaroo solver.

title: Embroidering Resonant Circuits for Inductive Pressure Sensing
summary: A fully embroidered LC resonant circuit (coil and capacitor from one continuous enameled wire) layered with polyurethane foam and an embroidered ferromagnetic yarn forms a soft textile inductive pressure sensor read by an LDC1614.

title: eTactileKit: A Toolkit for Design Exploration and Rapid Prototyping of Electro-Tactile Interfaces
summary: eTactileKit is an open-source electro-tactile toolkit with stackable 270V controller and switching hardware, an electrode interface design tool, a Processing pattern creator, a calibration GUI and Python and Unity APIs.

title: Extendlibur: Dynamic Haptic Retargeting for Length-Mismatched Proxies in Co-Located VR
summary: A dynamic haptic retargeting technique that simultaneously shifts and rotates two virtual sticks so identical 60 cm physical props, tracked with OptiTrack, represent virtual swords of different lengths for two co-located VR users.

title: FabObscura: Computational Design and Fabrication for Interactive Barrier-Grid Animations
summary: FabObscura is a computational design tool and parameterization (unit function, thickness, direction) for authoring and fabricating sliding, view-dependent, rotational and nested barrier-grid animations with interlaced images and barrier patterns.

title: FiberCircuits: A Miniaturization Framework To Manufacture Fibers That Embed Integrated Circuits
summary: FiberCircuits is a framework to miniaturize flexible PCBs with an STM32 microcontroller, accelerometers, magnetometer, touch sensing and addressable LEDs into millimeter-wide fibers, encapsulated in PDMS or braiding and woven, knitted or embroidered into textiles.

title: ForcePinch: Force-Responsive Spatial Interaction for Tracking Speed Control in XR
summary: A finger-worn thin-film pressure sensor with ESP32 unit that measures thumb-index pinch force on a Meta Quest 3 headset to continuously control the tracking speed of a mid-air pointer during object manipulation.

title: GyFoam: Fabricating Lattice Foam with Customizable Stiffness through Uniform Expansion
summary: A fabrication method that casts thermo-expandable microsphere (TEM) and Ecoflex silicone composite into 3D-printed sacrificial PVA molds with Gyroid lattice structure, then heats it to foam into lightweight objects with tunable stiffness and shape.

title: HeatFlow: A Thermal-Tactile Display for Dynamic 2D Thermal Movements
summary: HeatFlow: a wearable thermal-tactile display with a 3x3 grid of ERM vibrotactile actuators and one Peltier thermal actuator, driven by a phantom-point algorithm to render 2D thermal flows, plus a tablet-and-pen authoring tool.

title: HydroHaptics: High-Fidelity Force-Feedback on Soft Deformable Interfaces using Hydrostatic Transmission
summary: HydroHaptics couples a BLDC-motor-driven Haptic Engine to soft deformable interfaces (cast silicone dome, 3D-printed TPU bellows, heat-sealed TPU pouch) through a water-filled Hydraulic Cell with a rolling diaphragm (hydrostatic transmission) for high-fidelity force feedback and pressure-based input sensing.

title: Image-based Tactile Rendering Method Using Frequency Modulation under the Weber Fractions Constraint by Electrovibration
summary: An electrovibration tactile rendering method for a custom electrostatic touchscreen that maps Haralick correlation features of image texels to variable-frequency square wave voltage signals constrained by measured frequency Weber fractions (just noticeable differences).

title: Imaginary Joint: Proprioceptive Feedback for Virtual Body Extensions via Skin Stretch
summary: A waist-worn pair of rack-and-pinion skin-stretch devices that convey a virtual tail's angle and torque as superposed skin-stretch around an 'Imaginary Joint', tested in VR against voice-coil vibrotactile feedback.

title: Kinethreads: Soft Full-Body Haptic Exosuit using Low-Cost Motor-Pulley Mechanisms
summary: Kinethreads is a low-cost, string-driven full-body haptic exosuit for VR built from ten BLDC gimbal motor reels, pulleys and capstans on a MOLLE vest, rendering kinesthetic forces up to 120N and vibration up to 200Hz.

title: KiriInflate: Fabricating Cross-Scale Inflatables with Large Contraction and Tunable Stretchability for Tangible Interaction
summary: A fabrication method that uses static cling between thin PE film layers and a standard Laserbox 2.0 laser cutter to cut and heat-weld in one pass, making kirigami-slit inflatable actuators with a parametric design tool.

title: LightLink: Enhancing Smartwatch Sensing and Actuation Through Visible Light Communication
summary: A plug-and-play toolkit that adds sensor and actuator add-ons (tilt, buttons, temperature, alcohol, color, IR remote, LED matrix, vibration band) to a Google Pixel Watch 3 using visible light communication via its ambient light sensor and screen.

title: LuxAct: Enhance Everyday Objects for Visual Sensing with Interaction-Powered Illumination
summary: Interaction-powered illumination: piezoelectric striking and plucking power generators in everyday objects light a tri-color RGB LED in Color Shift Keying sequences that encode object ID and sensed values for an RGB point-of-view camera on AR headsets to decode.

title: MagnePins: A Modular, Affordable, and DIY Refreshable Braille and Tactile Display
summary: MagnePins is a low-cost DIY refreshable braille and tactile pin display in which a manually slid carriage of electromagnetic pistons sets and latches a passive 24 x 89 fabric-pin array.

title: MagTex: Machine-Knitted Magnetoactive Textiles for Bidirectional Human-Machine Interface
summary: MagTex is a machine-knitted magnetoactive textile that pairs extruded NdFeB-silicone magnetoactive fibers with knitted magnet-wire electromagnets to sense motion by induction and give vibrotactile feedback in wearables.

title: Mallet-Based Assembly: Enabling Load-Bearing Laser-Cut Models
summary: Mallet-based assembly is an algorithm that adds sacrificial trapezoidal scaffolding and refines assembly order (constrain-before-insertion, tapered pins, rotary insertion) so laser-cut plywood models with tight box and T-joints can be hammered together without breaking.

title: Meta-antenna: Mechanically Frequency Reconfigurable Metamaterial Antennas
summary: Meta-antenna is a mechanically reconfigurable patch antenna built from laser-cut kirigami auxetic rubber metamaterial with conductive spray paint, whose resonance frequency shifts as it expands, retracts, bends or rotates, with an Ansys design tool and three applications.

title: Mod2Hap: Two Level Modular Haptic System for Body- and Hand- Interactions using Magnetorheological Fluid
summary: A two-level modular haptic system of frame blocks plus magnetorheological (MR) fluid rotary and linear haptic blocks that give passive resistive kinesthetic feedback for body-scale and hand-scale VR interactions such as cycling, kayaking and fishing.

title: MorphingSkin: A Skin-like Platform that Integrates Multimodal Hydraulic Actuators Based on Flexible Electroosmotic Pumps
summary: A skin-like platform of flexible electroosmotic pump (EOP) hydraulic actuators on flexible printed circuits with silicone shells, giving force, shape, optical and weight actuation for robot skins, wearables, tangible displays and lampshades.

title: MorphKeys: A Reconfigurable Keyboard System Using Switched NFC Tags
summary: A reconfigurable keyboard of battery-free key units built on switched NFC tags, read by an NFC reader with relay resonators and fixed in 3D with ferrite magnets on an iron sand and clay base.

title: Move with Style! Enhancing Avatar Embodiment in Virtual Reality through Proprioceptive Motion Feedback
summary: Proprioceptive motion styles: an arm-based exoskeleton built with ExoKit and a Unity design tool render avatar motion properties (weight, speed, range of motion, targeting) in real time while the user embodies avatars in VR.

title: NarraGuide: an LLM-based Narrative Mobile Robot for Remote Place Exploration
summary: A TurtleBot3 Waffle mobile robot with a smartphone on a rod uses LiDAR SLAM navigation and GPT-4 dialogue grounded in an annotated museum map to guide remote users through a geology museum.

title: Personalized Bistable Orthoses for Rehabilitation of Finger Joints
summary: A single-piece 3D-printed compliant bistable finger brace that snaps between a stiff immobilizing state and a flexible state without power, plus a simulation-driven computational design pipeline that personalizes it to finger metrics and strengths.

title: PricoEye: The Eye of Primary Colors for Fast and Convenient 3D Reconstruction of Fine-grained Palmprint on Smartphones
summary: A smartphone add-on with 12 LEDs (including RGB LEDs) on a four-layer PCB plus a companion Android app that reconstructs ridge-level 3D palmprints using photometric stereo with TDM and FDM flash modes.

title: Primed Action: Preserving Agency while Accelerating Reaction Time via Subthreshold Brain Stimulation
summary: Primed Action uses a single subthreshold transcranial magnetic stimulation pulse to the motor cortex to speed up reactions without involuntary movement, preserving sense of agency better than electrical muscle stimulation.

title: ProForm: Solder-Free Circuit Assembly Using Thermoforming
summary: ProForm is a solder-free circuit assembly method that holds SMD components on a PCB with anisotropic conductive film (z-tape) and a pressure-formed PETG thermoplastic layer, so components can be reused and replaced.

title: QUILT: Supporting Modular Design of Machine-Knitting Programs
summary: A system that loads independent knitout machine-knitting programs as swatches, arranges them in a quilt layout through a web interface, and merges them course-wise and wale-wise into one seamless knitting program.

title: Reality Promises: Virtual-Physical Decoupling Illusions in Mixed Reality via Invisible Mobile Robots
summary: Reality Promises: video-passthrough mixed reality illusions on a Meta Quest 3 that hide a Hello Robot Stretch 3 mobile manipulator with on-device robot-aware 3D Gaussian splatting while it physically carries out the user's or a virtual character's object manipulations.

title: Refashion: Reconfigurable Garments via Modular Design
summary: A modular garment system of snap- or brad-connected foundation, pleat and dart fabric modules, with a design tool that decomposes garment patterns into a minimal module set by integer linear programming and simulates them on body models.

title: RingByte: Enhancing Text-Entry Practicality via A Singular Wearable Rotating Smart Ring
summary: A custom double-layer smart ring with a rotating outer layer holding a 9-axis IMU lets users type on a T9 layout by rotating, tapping, waving and pinching, decoded with a cross-domain attention domain-adaptation model and an n-gram language model.

title: Sculptable Mesh Structures for Large-Scale Form-Finding
summary: A room-scale gridshell of hand-adjustable T-Modules (sliding flexible FR4 bands with resistive-ladder length sensors) whose sensed edge lengths are reconstructed in Rhino/Kangaroo into a digital mesh for CAD and CNC fabrication.

title: SignGlass: First-Person View Comprehensive and Generalizable ASL Translation Using Wearable Glass
summary: Three miniature RGB cameras (OV5647 by Arducam) on one pair of smart glasses, driven by Raspberry Pi Zero boards, capture manual and non-manual ASL markers for deep-learning (EgoCorrNet, EgoFaceNet) recognition and gloss-to-English translation.

title: SoilSense: Appropriating Soil-based Microbial Fuel Cells to Create Tangible Interfaces
summary: Soil-based microbial fuel cells (SMFCs) with carbon felt electrodes are used as pressure sensors whose output voltage rises when the cathode is pressed, embedded in 3D-printed TPU containers for pressing, twisting and bending input.

title: SparseEMG: Computational Design of Sparse EMG Layouts for Sensing Gestures
summary: A computational design tool that recommends sparse surface EMG electrode layouts for a chosen gesture set (via Permutation Importance and Random Forest) and generates personalized placement stencils.

title: StitchFlow: Enabling In-Situ Creative Explorations of Crochet Patterns With Stitch Tracking and Process Sharing
summary: StitchFlow: a crochet hook with an embedded IMU and a foot switch recognizes stitches (chain, single, double crochet) with a random forest classifier and automatically builds editable node-graph, chart and written crochet patterns in a web interface.

title: StringTouch: A Non-occlusive 3DoF Haptic Interface Using String Structures for Modulating Finger Sensations
summary: A wrist-actuated, non-occlusive 3DoF fingertip haptic device that pulls thin nylon string structures through Bowden cables to deform the finger pad and modulate perceived stiffness, orientation and weight of tangible proxies in VR.

title: SustainaPrint: Making the Most of Eco-Friendly Filaments
summary: SustainaPrint simulates stress with finite element analysis and segments a model so high-stress regions print in virgin filament and the rest in eco-friendly filament on a dual-extrusion printer, with a 3D-printable home filament testing toolkit.

title: Talking Spell: A Wearable System Enabling Real-Time Anthropomorphic Voice Interaction with Everyday Objects
summary: A wearable pair of a camera-based scope (XIAO ESP32S3 Sense with OV2640) and a touch-and-vibration wand that detect everyday objects and give them LLM-generated personas and speech via YOLOv11, Qwen-VL, Faster Whisper, GPT and Coqui TTS.

title: Texergy: Textile-based Harvesting, Storing, and Releasing of Mechanical Energy for Passive On-Body Actuation
summary: Texergy is a textile-based framework of laser-cut fabric latch mechanisms and elastic rubber cords that harvest energy from user movements, store it on the body, and release it on demand to passively actuate on-body outputs.

title: Touch-n-Curl: Designing and Constructing Skeletal Form through 3D Printing Flattened Zipper Assembly
summary: Touch-n-Curl: a parametric 3D printed rigid zipper design and Grasshopper/Rhino inverse design pipeline that flattens 3D skeletal tree and mesh forms into 2D zipper assemblies printed on an FDM 3D printer and assembled by hand.

title: Towards Unobtrusive Physical AI: Augmenting Everyday Objects with Intelligence and Robotic Movement for Proactive Assistance
summary: A perceive-reason-act system in which a ceiling-mounted camera, vision language models and LLMs infer user goals and drive everyday objects (knife, trivets, mug, stapler) augmented with small two-wheeled robotic platforms to move proactively and assist or protect users.

title: Transforming Everyday Objects into Dynamic Interfaces using Smart Flat-Foldable Structures
summary: A flat, self-contained motion layer that makes everyday tabletop objects locomote, pairing a vibration-motor energy layer with a steering layer of flat-foldable compliant legs folded out by liquid crystal elastomer actuators.

title: TwinSpin: A Virtual Ball in a VR Controller Enabling In-Hand 3DoF Rotation
summary: TwinSpin: a power-grip VR controller with two embedded 6 mm optical mini-trackballs (thumb and index finger) that give in-hand 3DoF rotation of virtual objects through a virtual ball metaphor.

title: Typing Haptically: Towards Enabling Non-auditory Smartphone Text Entry with Haptic Feedback for Blind and Low Vision Users
summary: A smartphone add-on with piezoelectric actuators on both sides delivering phoneme-based two-channel haptic feedback per letter key, plus a tactile overlay marking the middle QWERTY row, enabling non-auditory text entry for blind and low vision users.

title: Ultra-low-power ring-based wireless tinymouse
summary: An ultra-low-power wireless ring mouse that sends trackball scroll and press input to a wristband coil through semi-passive passive inductive telemetry with frequency-shift keying and a balanced bridge impedance readout.

title: Using an Array of Needles to Create Solid Knitted Shapes
summary: A proof-of-concept solid knitting machine with a 6x6 array of individually actuated symmetrical double-hook needles, loop transfer tools and a compactor that knits solid 3D forms such as an open box, a C-shape and a quarter inverted pyramid.

title: Vestibular Stimulation Enhances Hand Redirection
summary: Galvanic vestibular stimulation (GVS) applied via electrodes behind the ears sways the user's body toward the expected center-of-gravity, raising detection thresholds of VR hand redirection by up to about 55%.

title: VisRing: A Display-Extended Smartring for Nano Visualizations
summary: A display-extended smartring built on a 4-layer flexible PCB with a 160 x 32 4-bit grayscale bendable OLED display, IMU, PPG and temperature sensors and BLE, plus a firmware library for nano visualizations.

title: ViviClay: Designing and Fabricating Ceramics with Animation Effects on Physical Surfaces
summary: ViviClay is a method that 3D prints clay with pipes embedded in ceramic walls and coats them with thermochromic paint so hot water flowing through the pipes creates animated color-change effects, with a Rhino Grasshopper design tool.

title: WORM: Programming Collaborative Robots Through Manual Actions for Craft-Aligned Digital Fabrication
summary: A cobot programming system (Workflow-Oriented Robotic Manufacturing) lets artists record manual craft actions by guiding a UR10e through a custom handle controller, then replay them with procedural repetitions for painting and foam-carved ceramic molds.

title: Wrist2Finger: Sensing Fingertip Force for Force-Aware Hand Interaction with a Ring-Watch Wearable
summary: A ring-watch wearable combining a single IMU-equipped thumb ring and a smartwatch-integrated single-channel dry-electrode EMG sensor, with a dual-branch cross-attention transformer to estimate hand pose and fingertip force.

title: AeroPixels: Repurposing Ubiquitous Displays as Imperceptible Schlieren Light Sources for Airflow Interaction
summary: A projection-mapping focusing-schlieren airflow imaging system that embeds a source grid and its inverse into projected content alternated at 120 Hz, captured by a synchronized schlieren camera with geometric compensation and noise removal.

title: AquaWeave: Weaving Liquid-Activated Morphing Bio-Textiles
summary: Liquid-activated morphing bio-textiles woven on a digital jacquard loom with wet-spun alginate, chitosan and gelatin bioyarn wefts that swell or dissolve, with a design menu of weave structures.

title: Armonii: Motion Design for Wearable Supernumerary Robotic Arms Toward Comfort and Embodiment
summary: A threshold-aware supportive motion framework for a backpack-mounted bilateral wearable supernumerary robotic arm (WRA) in which the inactive arm moves to reduce gravity- and actuation-induced torque on the wearer while preserving embodiment.

title: Beyond Dense Sensing: Biomechanically-Guided Hand Pose Reconstruction from Reduced Observations
summary: A sparse six-flexible-strain-sensor wearable with a biomechanically-guided observation reduction and graph-plus-multi-scale-Transformer model that reconstructs full-hand 3D pose, evaluated against an optical tracker and in a VR paper-cutting coaching study.

title: Bifur-circuits: Interactive and Modular Metamaterial Building Blocks Via Bifurcated Geometries
summary: Bifur-circuits are multi-material 3D-printed auxetic kirigami metamaterial units and connector blocks with internal conductive TPU routing that press-fit into 3D assemblies whose bifurcated configurations are sensed electrically via I2C.

title: BlimpMate: A Quiet, Long-Endurance Flying Display for Hands-Free Intelligent Interaction
summary: BlimpMate is a helium-filled indoor blimp flying display robot that rear-projects onto its own envelope with an ultra-lightweight MEMS laser beam scanning projector, with custom flight control and an AI-supported networked interaction stack.

title: CapAura: A Proxemic Interactive Infrastructure on Everyday Furniture through Capacitive Architecture Unit
summary: CapAura: a floor-to-ceiling mutual-capacitance field from a 3x5 grid of metal floor tiles and ceiling aluminum foil, extended by unmodified conductive furniture, with neural networks recognizing position, identity, movement and orientation and driving spatial hotkeys.

title: Cardinal Pressure Pulses Rendered by a Wristband Can Elicit Phantom Directional Cues
summary: SuperCUTE is a 15-gram wristband with four soft cutaneous electrohydraulic (CUTE) oil-filled pouch actuators at the wrist's cardinal positions that use pressure-pulse funneling illusion to render 360-degree directional cues for XR.

title: CineHaptic: Context-Aware Real-Time Audiovisual-to-Haptic Rendering System for In-Vehicle 4D Cinematic Experiences
summary: A real-time audiovisual-to-haptic rendering system for in-car 4D cinema that classifies sound event salience, localizes event sound sources in the video, and drives a six-voice-coil-actuator haptic seat installed in a Kia EV9 with synchronized spatiotemporal patterns.

title: Co-opting Mobile Device Cellular RF Front Ends for HCI Sensing
summary: Repurposes the cellular RF front end (antenna impedance tuning and power tracking) of an off-the-shelf smartphone as a VNA-like S11 sensor for grip pose, worn placement, passive widget cases, accessories and surface recognition.

title: Dishplay: Edible Display Utilizing Magnetic Response of Iron in Cereal
summary: Dishplay, an edible display that magnetically arranges crushed iron-fortified cereal particles in liquid over neodymium magnet units, static on a 3D-printed 8x8 grid or dynamic with an 8x8 linear actuator array.

title: EIJaw: Non-Invasive Intraoral User Interface with Electrical Impedance Sensing
summary: A non-invasive electrical impedance sensing prototype with a 16-channel measurement unit and flexible on-skin jaw electrode array that characterizes intraoral movement (kana pronunciation, silent pronunciation, tongue position) using a 1D-CNN.

title: EITWatch: Smartwatch-Integrated Planar Electrical Impedance Tomography for Hand Gesture Recognition
summary: Smartwatch case-back with a custom PCB of eight planar gold-plated electrodes in a 31 mm ring that performs electrical impedance tomography with multi-depth scanning to recognize macro and micro hand gestures from the dorsal wrist.

title: ElectroPad: Extending Gamepad Haptics for Hand Movements in Video Games with Electrotactile Feedback
summary: ElectroPad is a pair of 2 mm-thick electrotactile covers for the PS5 DualSense gamepad, with 190 electrodes per hand in a dual-material 3D-printed shell over a flexible printed circuit, rendering fine-grained tactile feedback for hand movements in video games.

title: Electrotactile Retargeting in Orientation Perception of Teleoperated Tools
summary: Electrotactile retargeting renders pressure-distribution patterns on the palm with two flexible electrode arrays attached to a Quest 2 controller, so operators perceive a teleoperated tool's orientation despite controller-tool misalignment, based on a fitted second-order separable model.

title: ExtenString: Enhancing String-Based Interaction with Virtual Screens through Remapping
summary: ExtenString connects a passive fixed-length string between the user's fingertip and the VR HMD to give haptic cues on a spherical workspace, using movement remapping to operate flat virtual screens.

title: FabDreamer: Exploring the Image-to-Physical Workflow Through AI-Assisted Layered Fabrication
summary: FabDreamer is a web-based AI system that decomposes an image into depth-ordered layers with SAM2 and generative occlusion inpainting, lets users compose them with 3D preview, and checks floating and thin features with a fabrication agent before exporting SVGs for layered laser-cut art.

title: Faster Than Muscle: Executing Action based on Voluntary Nervous Signals
summary: Faster Than Muscle is a human-in-the-loop action acceleration system that detects voluntary EMG onset with Mu-BORG and Teensy 4.0 and drives an electromagnet-moved finger, HID game input, or an INSPIRE-ROBOTICS bionic hand within the electromechanical delay.

title: FlexiFab: Laser-Cutting Volumetric Compliant Structures with Tunable-Stiffness
summary: A fabrication method and Grasshopper/Rhino design tool for laser-cutting volumetric, load-bearing compliant structures from kerf-patterned lattice plates with planar-threaded interlocking joints and nuts that tune stiffness after fabrication.

title: From Scaffolding to Internalization: Enhancing CPR Training with In-Situ Visualization and Kinesthetic Feedback
summary: A CPR training system with a custom hybrid spring-pneumatic manikin whose chest resistance is actively modulated via a proportional electro-pneumatic valve, plus a HoloLens 2 in-situ visual feedback ring on the chest and a three-stage fading schedule.

title: Granular I/O: Enabling Bi-directional Malleable Interaction for Actuated TUIs with Magnetic Particles
summary: Granular I/O actuates clusters of millimeter-scale magnetic particles (magnets in 3D-printed shells) with electromagnet or linearly actuated permanent magnet arrays and camera sensing, for malleable bidirectional tangible interaction.

title: GuitarFins: Skillful Input Triggering with a Guitar Pick
summary: GuitarFins: spring-returned, magnet-equipped 3D-printed fins with hall sensors (49E) and an ESP32S3, integrated into an electric guitar's body, triggered with a guitar pick to send key presses for controlling software.

title: Halftoning for 3D Printed Textile Nets
