summary: A halftoning workflow that turns a grayscale image into a continuous two-layer G-code toolpath, modulating extrusion (E-factor) and feed speed with two flexible TPU filaments on an FDM printer to print multicolor patterned textile nets, with a Grasshopper and browser design tool.

title: HapTap: Ultrashort, Low Power Pulses for Localized Fingertip Haptics
summary: A 2 × 4 fingertip array of 6 mm linear resonant actuators on a soft silicone sleeve, driven by ultra-short (≤1 ms) high-voltage pulses to give localized tap-like sensations with low power.

title: HueRistic: Optimizing Lighting for Live Video Color Design
summary: A camera-in-the-loop system that uses computer-controlled 8x8 RGB LED matrices and nonlinear optimization of a calibrated scene-appearance model to find physical lighting settings meeting color harmony or target color goals in live video.

title: Inertia in Your Hand: Rendering Virtual Tool Dynamics via In-Hand Cutaneous Deformation
summary: The Inertia Handle is a 2-DOF servo-tilted, grip-force-sensing handheld VR handle that renders virtual tool dynamics (length, direction, inertia) as in-hand cutaneous deformation driven by a Unity spring-damper hand-tool simulation.

title: InstructMesh: Selective Refinement of Generative 3D Models for Fabrication
summary: InstructMesh is an interactive web tool that lets novices repair fabrication-relevant flaws in generative 3D models by mapping region highlights and natural-language or slider edits to canonical latent voxel-grid operations on TRELLIS, with green/red previews.

title: Integrating Visual and Acoustic Modalities for Near-Eye Gaze Tracking
summary: A near-eye gaze tracker on an eyeglass frame that pairs a sparse near-eye infrared camera (PCCR) with an ultrasonic FMCW speaker-microphone array, fusing them with an error-state Kalman filter for low-power, high-rate, re-wearing-robust gaze.

title: InvisiSpeech: Making Silent Speech Invisible through a Miniature Intraoral Sensor
summary: A wireless, waterproof intraoral silent speech interface: a biocompatible resin brace with a flexible PCB and Voice Pickup Unit (VPU) clipped to the teeth, decoded with an adapted Whisper model.

title: InvisIto: Weaving Unobtrusive Infrared Markers for Ubiquitous Textile Interaction
summary: InvisIto weaves visually unobtrusive QR codes and ArUco markers into textiles using NIR-absorbing yarn in double weave, with a weaving-draft design tool, five disguising strategies and an NIR camera pipeline for decoding, binary input and deformation tracking.

title: iRing: Rich Interaction on Smart Ring with Multi-point Capacitive Touch Screen
summary: A smart ring that combines a flexible 160x32 OLED display with a transparent flexible-PCB self-capacitive multi-touch sensor (MPR121), enabling co-located on-ring input via six touch primitives called nano interactions.

title: Kneadix: A Multi-Process Loom with Dynamic Warp-Weft Role Assignment
summary: A heddle-less loom with horn gear actuators, closed-loop tension yarn carriers and a retractable scissor comb that dynamically reassigns warp and weft roles to weave, knit-like and braid in one seamless fabric.

title: KnitARobo: Industrial Machine Knitting of Electromechanical Textile Interfaces with Liquid Crystal Elastomer Fibers
summary: KnitARobo actuators are electromechanical textiles machine-knitted on industrial machines, using liquid crystal elastomer (LCE) fiber tendons floated between knitted anchors and an inlaid stainless steel yarn heating element, demonstrated as a haptic sleeve, flap display and flower.

title: LightShop: High-Precision Interactive Computational Light Painting
summary: LightShop is a low-cost light painting system where a projector casts slices of virtual emitters onto a handheld diffuse poi tracked by a Meta Quest 3 HMD, with AR planning and capture guidance and a computational exposure technique that subtracts ambient light.

title: LinkHydro: Design and Rapid Fabrication of Soft Self-Pumping Tubes for Prototyping Hydraulic Interface
summary: LinkHydro is a method and Rhinoceros/Grasshopper design support tool for rapidly fabricating soft self-pumping tubes, with spiral electrodes inside heat-shrink tubing driving silent EHD flow of Novec 7100, used in modular hydraulic systems.

title: MagicPen: Enabling Dynamic Physical Scaffolding through Haptic Feedback for 3D Content Creation in VR with a Variable-length Stylus
summary: MagicPen is a variable-length haptic stylus with a gear-rack mechanism driven by a DC motor that extends or retracts against a reference surface, giving grounded haptic feedback for 3D editing in VR through Dynamic Physical Scaffolding.

title: MagToTheFuture: Transforming Passive Objects into Circuit-Free Haptic Devices via Magnetic Fields
summary: A tabletop system senses the position and ID of passive magnetic patches on everyday objects with a Hall-sensor array and routes a dual-coil electromagnet and induction heater on a linear motion system to give them force, vibration and thermal feedback.

title: MBits: Multi-modality 3D-printed objects via resonance-tunable spring-mass units
summary: MBits are 3D-printed accordion spring-mass units with tunable natural frequencies that mechanically demultiplex a single vibration actuator's signal into haptic, acoustic, motion and visual outputs, with a Rhino/Grasshopper design toolkit.

title: MetaBeads: Enabling Shape- and Stiffness-Changing Interfaces through Beaded Metamaterials
summary: A craft-based approach using acrylic beads and monofilament fishing line woven in angle weaves with actuation strings and stabilizer beads to make shape- and stiffness-changing interfaces, plus a web design tool that simulates them and generates threading plans.

title: MetaCanvas: A Toolkit for Prototyping Tessellation-Based Shape-Changing Structures by Cut-and-Configure Authoring
summary: Prototyping toolkit of a reusable, cuttable Yoshimura/Kresling origami tessellation canvas with SMA-sheet and carbon-fiber-heater actuators, a Rhino/Grasshopper design interface and an ESP32-S3 Motion Setup Case for post-fabrication motion tuning.

title: Mirror Skin: In Situ Visualization of Robot Touch Intent on Robot Skin
summary: Mirror Skin conveys a robot's touch intent by displaying live, mirror-like reflections of the human body part on the robot's skin, prototyped with wide-angle cameras and thin displays on a Franka arm and Allegro hand and explored in VR.

title: MorphoChrome: Interactive, Handheld Fabrication of Programmable Structural Color
summary: A handheld optical device with red, green and blue laser diodes and dichroic mirror beam combining that writes angle-dependent structural color into holographic photopolymer film, with a Blender digital twin interface and UV-resin adhesion process.

title: MoTUI: Personalization of In-Vehicle Tactile Interfaces for People With Vision Impairments and the Blind
summary: MoTUI, an open-source reconfigurable modular tactile interface of servo-driven sliding, rising, rotating buttons, is paired with human-in-the-loop multi-objective Bayesian optimization (Optuna MOTPE) to personalize in-vehicle interfaces for people with vision impairments.

title: NailBender: Exploring Nail Flexion for Haptic Input and Output
summary: A nail-mounted piezoelectric bender plate with segmented electrodes, coupled to the fingernail through a 3D-printed spacer and fake nail, that senses nail flexion for force and micro-gesture input and renders haptic output.

title: Object-Agent Twins (OATs): Expressive Micro-Agent Avatars for Inanimate Everyday Objects
summary: A toolkit for Object-Agent Twins (OATs): ESP32-S3 e-ink devices with plug-in sensors plus a web app using Gemini to generate pixel-art avatars and infer emotions from an object's sensed state.

title: OmniTex: Omnidirectional Haptic Rendering of Surface Texture on VR Handheld Controller using 3-DOF Motion Mechanism
summary: A handheld VR controller-mounted haptic device with a 3-DOF motion mechanism (2-DOF rotation plus a rack-and-pinion texture-switching roller of real texture samples) that renders omnidirectional sliding surface texture under the fingertip.

title: Present Drawing: Exploring Avatar-Mediated Drawing Events with Physical Traces
summary: Present Drawing: a Meta Quest 3 pass-through MR system where an avatar appears to draw an autograph while a self-moving pen plotter with hidden magnetic actuation and magnetic pen-up/down leaves the physical marker trace on paper.

title: PressMic: Multi-Level Press Input on Commodity Devices Using Built-in Microphones
summary: A notched annulus placed around the rear microphone vent of an iPhone 15 turns the built-in microphone into a passive acoustic light-press versus hard-press input, recognized by a two-stage Random Forest pipeline.

title: Print & Place: Using a 3D printer for Continuous Assembly of Electronic Devices
summary: Print & Place is a technique that turns an unmodified FDM 3D printer (Prusa XL) into a pick-and-place machine, using cooled extruded PLA beads to embed PCBs, copper rivets and copper cloth traces into prints, with a Rhino/Grasshopper plugin generating trays and G-code.

title: Print&Fold: Printing and Folding Shape-accurate 3D Models
summary: A browser-based design tool that segments 3D models around a maximum inscribed rectangular-prism hollow core and unfolds them into flat nets with living hinges and peg-and-hole connectors, FDM printed flat in PLA and folded into shape-accurate objects.

title: Programmable Machine-Knitted Sensors for Deformable Interfaces
summary: A programmable machine-knitted three-layer capacitive sensing substrate with conductive yarn stripes, made on a Shima Seiki WholeGarment machine in elbow and shoulder forms, whose capacitance field a Fourier Neural Operator maps to the deforming fabric surface.

title: ProtoCall: Preemptive Physical Feedback for Sequential Skill Augmentation
summary: Wearable wire-based head and hand actuators (capstan-drive BLDC head puller, reel-puller wrist puller) with a dual-loop gaze/IMU/VLM inference system deliver preemptive physical nudging to prevent step-transition errors in sequential cooking-themed tasks.

title: PÅCKER: Making Large Laser-Cut Objects Easy-to-Store and Transport
summary: A software tool built into the Kyub laser-cut modeling tool with a split tool that decomposes closed-box laser-cut models into largely convex components, auto-selecting split planes and screw, cam-fitting or dowel connectors with generated internal structure for flat-pack shipping.

title: Reperceiving Everyday Sounds with Hidden Texture
summary: A wearable neckband with stereo microphones and open-ear headphones that detects pitch, ranks overtones with a real-time psychoacoustic model, and amplifies the most perceptually accessible overtone as an auditory cue so users reperceive hidden texture in everyday sounds.

title: RingIO: An Eyes-Free Smart Ring with Inputs via Touch and Outputs via Touch
summary: A smart ring prototype with a flexible PCB on a COLMI R02 Smart Ring that senses multi-touch via 16 capacitive electrodes on the outer surface and delivers collocated electrotactile stimulation on the inner surface for eyes-free interaction.

title: ShiftLens: Mechanically Actuated Optical Surfaces for Switchable Appearances on 3D Objects
summary: ShiftLens is a Rhino/Grasshopper design and fabrication system that 3D prints objects with a cylindrical lenticular lens layer over a pattern layer, shifted by a switch, roller or knob to change surface appearance without electronics.

title: SilkSense: A Craft-Inspired Fabrication Method for Silk-based Functional Interfaces
summary: A craft-inspired two-stage fabric-level method makes conductive silk textiles: Dioscorea cirrhosa polyphenol pretreatment, then blade-coated Fe-HA/FA and PEDOT:PSS composite, giving washable piezoresistive pressing, bending and pinching sensors.

title: Spray and Etch: Personal Fabrication of High-Resolution Electroluminescent Displays
summary: A personal fabrication process for high-resolution electroluminescent displays that alternates hand-held spraying of Lumilor EL layers with direct and depth-selective laser etching on an unmodified laser cutter, enabling 0.4mm-pixel passive matrices, multicolour pixels and non-planar surfaces.

title: StitchSwitch: Programmable Surface Deformation and Bistability in Embroidered Textiles
summary: StitchSwitch: computational design and fabrication system that embroiders triangle-tessellated patches (diameter, fill percentage) onto pre-stretched elastic fabric to program passive bistable deformation, with a simulation-based design tool and garment applications.

title: SwapSense: Reusable Vision-Based Contact Force Sensing Across Swappable Passive Haptic Modules
summary: A vision-based modular haptic I/O framework combining a shared 3D-printed auxetic lattice sensing module imaged by a fisheye camera (ResNet-18/BiLSTM force estimation) with interchangeable passive haptic augmentation cells.

title: TagTutor: Restoring Practice Visibility for Guitar Tutoring in Private Listening Settings
summary: A guitar tutoring system that senses string vibration with a passive paper-thin UHF RFID tag on the fretboard read by an Impinj R420, recovers notes via sparse recovery, and gives two-level tablature error feedback.

title: Tap2Stop: Pedestrian-Activated Emergency Stop for Autonomous Vehicles
summary: Tap2Stop lets pedestrians stop an autonomous vehicle by tapping its surface, using an interior wireless microphone and two TabPFN classifiers with a gating and confidence-accumulation trigger, tested on a modified golf cart.

title: TeethMark: Enabling Tongue-Tooth Interaction with Capacitive Sensing and Electrotactile Feedback using an Intraoral Wearable
summary: TeethMark is a customized 3D-printed dental-resin brace with a four-layer flexible PCB of per-tooth electrodes that senses tongue gestures capacitively and gives electrotactile feedback on the tongue and inner lip.

title: Textro: A Prototyping Toolkit for Solderless and Chipless Smart Textile Interfaces
summary: A solderless prototyping toolkit for chipless smart textile interfaces: a web-based design environment generates embroidery and cutting files for embroidered RLC circuits and fabric sensors glued by capacitive coupling and read wirelessly by a NanoVNA reader.

title: The Future of 5DOF Laser Cutting Is Personal
summary: A desktop 5DOF diode laser cutter built by adding motorized head tilt and a rotating table to an iKier Pro 70W, plus SVG5DOF, an Illustrator plugin and converters for hidden joints, dovetails and cut-in-place mechanisms.

title: TherMosaic: Accelerating Perceived Thermal Transitions Through Spatiotemporal Thermal Feedback
summary: TherMosaic is a 2x2 fingertip Peltier thermal display (benchtop and standalone wearable) that preconditions diagonal subregions using spatial summation and thermal adaptation to accelerate perceived hot/cold transitions, evaluated in VR.

title: TypeRing: Ten-Finger Surface Typing with Dual IMU Rings
summary: TypeRing is ten-finger surface typing using two custom IMU rings with touchpads on the index fingers, optionally fused with a front-facing RGB camera for touch positions, decoded by an augmented Bayesian decoder.

title: V-Hook: Morphology-Mediated Vibration-Driven Locomotion through 3D-Printed Hook Structures
summary: Arrays of FDM 3D-printed full, tilted, half and double hook structures on a base that turn uniform vibration into directional stick-slip locomotion, with a Grasshopper design tool and online sharing platform.

title: X-Hinges: 3D Printing Self-Sensing Compliant Mechanisms for Continuous and Multi-DOF Motion Sensing
summary: X-Hinges are single-print, multi-material FDM 3D-printed compliant (LET joint) mechanisms with high- and low-resistivity conductive TPU filaments that self-sense continuous multi-DOF motion, read out by custom hardware and a TCN decoder.

title: XTick: Rendering Omnidirectional Hit-and-Hold Impact Feedback All Round a Controller by Integrating Impact and Pressing Force
summary: XTick is a handheld VR controller that renders omnidirectional instant and hit-and-hold impact by combining a spring impactor on rotatable tracks with two rotatable extrudable and tiltable 3DoF Stewart-platform modules for pressing force.
